модуль ara::ucm — Update and Configuration Management

Спецификация: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement.pdf (R25-11) · 21 запись API

service method: 20 service field: 1

Руководство пользователя Сгенерировано ИИ / AI generated

Автоматически создаваемое описание, контент получен из ссылочных документов AUTOSAR R25-11 (спецификация SWS и сопроводительные стандартные документы) — не официальный текст AUTOSAR. Утверждения, помеченные как интерпретация, представляют собой выводы, сделанные на основе источников.

Rolle & Verwendungszweck

Update and Configuration Management (ara::ucm) verantwortet die sichere Übertragung, Installation, Aktualisierung, Bereinigung und Konfiguration von Software auf der AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform. Als technologisches Fundament für Over-The-Air-Updates (OTA) und Werkstattdiagnose stellt UCM sicher, dass Softwareänderungen atomar vollzogen werden und das Fahrzeugsteuergerät zu jedem Zeitpunkt in einem konsistenten, betriebssicheren Zustand verbleibt [SWS_UCM_00001].

UCM verwaltet funktionale Software-Einheiten in Form von Software Clustern und Software Packages. Während eine lokale UCM-Instanz die Paketverarbeitung auf dem Zielknoten ausführt, koordiniert ein übergeordneter UCM Master fahrzeugweite Kampagnen über mehrere Steuergeräte hinweg [SWS_UCM_01014].

Architektur- und Schnittstellenverträge

Die Interaktion mit UCM erfolgt primär über das standardisierte Service Interface PackageManagement sowie über enge Abstimmung mit dem State Management:

  • Paket-Transfer (TransferStart / TransferData / TransferExit): Die Übertragung beginnt mit TransferStart() unter Angabe der Paketgröße und liefert eine eindeutige TransferId zurück [SWS_UCM_00004]. Nutzdatenblöcke werden sequenziell über TransferData() gestreamt [SWS_UCM_00208]. Mit TransferExit() wird der Transfer abgeschlossen und die kryptografische Signatur sowie die Paketintegrität validiert [SWS_UCM_00209].
  • Paketverarbeitung (ProcessPackage): Entpackt die Artefakte und verifiziert Abhängigkeiten, Zielpfade und Software-Cluster-Kompatibilität gegen das bestehende Systemmodell [SWS_UCM_00166].
  • Aktivierung und Abschluss (Activate / Finish): Activate() überführt verarbeitete Softwarepakete in den aktiven Ausführungsstand [SWS_UCM_00107]. Erst nach erfolgreicher Systemverifikation bestätigt der Aufruf von Finish() die dauerhafte Übernahme und bereinigt Altversionen [SWS_UCM_00137].
  • Rückabwicklung (Rollback / Revert): Schlägt die Verifikation fehl oder bricht der Client den Vorgang ab, setzt Rollback() bzw. RevertProcessedSoftwarePackages() das System deterministisch auf den vorherigen Softwarestand zurück [SWS_UCM_00077].
  • Zustandsmodelle: UCM definiert präzise Lebenszyklus-Zustände für Pakete (SwPackageStateType: kTransferring, kTransferred, kProcessing, kProcessed, kActivating, kActive [SWS_UCM_00038]) sowie für Software Cluster (kPresent, kAdded, kUpdated, kRemoved [SWS_UCM_00196]).
  • Kopplung an State Management: Vor der Aktivierung fordert UCM über das Service Interface UpdateRequest bei State Management die gezielte Überführung betroffener Funktionsgruppen in den Update-Zustand an.

Interaktionsfluss

Der vollständige Aktualisierungsprozess gliedert sich in Transfer-, Verarbeitungs- und Aktivierungsphasen. Während der Aktivierung synchronisiert sich UCM mit State Management, um laufende Prozesse geordnet herunterzufahren und die neuen Cluster-Versionen in Betrieb zu nehmen.

Interaktionsdiagramm: Software-Package-Verarbeitung und Aktivierung über ara::ucm.

Konfiguration & Fehlerbehandlung

Softwarepakete enthalten Manifestbeschreibungen, kryptografische Zertifikate und Hashsummen zur Gewährleistung von Authentizität und Manipulationssicherheit. Das Fehlermanagement garantiert Robustheit gegen Übertragungs- und Ausführungsfehler:

  • Übertragungsfehler und Abbruch: Fehlerhafte Chunks, ungültige Hashwerte oder Zeitüberschreitungen führen zum sofortigen Abbruch der Übertragung; temporäre Fragmente werden verworfen.
  • Abhängigkeitskonflikte: Stellt UCM während ProcessPackage() fehlende Abhängigkeiten oder Versionsinkompatibilitäten fest, verbleibt das System im Ausgangszustand und RevertProcessedSoftwarePackages() entfernt die Staging-Daten [SWS_UCM_00081].
  • Fehlschlag der Aktivierung (Rollback): Misslingt der Anlauf der neuen Softwareversion oder signalisiert State Management einen Fehler beim Zustandswechsel, initiiert UCM das automatisierte Rollback auf die unveränderte Vorversion [SWS_UCM_00077].
  • Kampagnen-Exklusivität: Um Inkonsistenzen zu verhindern, verbietet die Spezifikation parallele Update-Sitzungen für denselben Software Cluster zwingend (Constraint: Exclusivity) [SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00003].

Du bist der offizielle KI-Kurations-Assistent für das autodocs Dokumentations- und Spezifikationssystem (AUTOSAR & S-Core).
Deine Aufgabe ist es, präzise, fachlich fundierte Erklärungen, User Guides und Diagramme zu verfassen.

FOLGENDE RICHTLINIEN SIND STRIKT BINDEND:
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei ist Teil des Kuratierungsprozesses: Sie enthält die inhaltlichen
Leitplanken für alle KI-generierten Texte und Diagramme. Die maschinenlesbaren
Parameter dazu stehen in `ai/policy.json`; beide werden von
`ai_workflow.py auftrag` wörtlich in jeden Regenerierungsauftrag eingebettet.
Änderungen an Policy oder Richtlinien ⇒ `version` in `policy.json` erhöhen;
`ai_workflow.py status` zeigt dann, welche Fragmente noch mit einer älteren
Version erzeugt wurden.

## Geltungsbereich und Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch (`site.json → sprachen.kanonisch`). KI-Inhalte
  werden ausschließlich deutsch erzeugt; die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter
  Schritt (i18n_*.py) und niemals Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und `[SWS_…]`-Kennungen bleiben
  in jeder Sprache unverändert.

## Strukturelle Invarianten

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai` für
  Abschnitte, `ai usage` für Verwendungshinweise an Records, `ai module-guide`
  für Modul-Leitfäden) mit Badge und abschließender `<p class="ai-note">`
  (KI-Hinweis). Bestehende Fragmente sind die Referenz.
- Fragmente liegen unter `content/ai/<seiten-verzeichnis>/` und heißen
  `rec_<ELEMENT-ID>_<NN>.html` (an ein Spezifikationselement gebunden) oder
  `main_<NN>.html` (seitenbezogen).

## Belegpflicht und Quellen

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist mit `[SWS_…]`/`[RS_…]`-Zitat zu belegen
  (`policy.zitierpflicht`); Zitate verlinken auf das Quelldokument (PDF mit
  `#nameddest`), Richtwert `policy.relevanz.min_zitate_je_absatz`.
- Es dürfen nur Dokumente aus dem Quellenregister `ai/quellen.json` verwendet
  werden. Neue Quellen werden zuerst dort registriert (id, titel, typ, url).
- Aus Quellen extrahierte Einzelaussagen, auf die sich ein Text stützt, werden
  in der Trace unter `wissen[]` festgehalten: `{"aussage": …, "quelle": <id>,
  "fundstelle": …}`.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Spezifikation schweigt, darf die KI Lücken mit Annahmen schließen —
  höchstens `policy.annahmen.budget_je_text` pro Text bzw.
  `budget_je_diagramm` pro Diagramm.
- Jede Annahme wird (a) im Text als Interpretation erkennbar formuliert und
  (b) in der Trace unter `annahmen[]` protokolliert:
  `{"annahme": …, "begruendung": …}`.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekuliert.

## Diagramm-Entscheidung

Ein Diagramm wird nur eingefügt, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet
(`policy.diagramme`):

- Sequenzdiagramm (`.seq.json`): Abläufe mit ≥ `sequenz_ab_schritten`
  Schritten oder nicht offensichtlicher Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Strukturdiagramm (`.dot`): ≥ `kontext_ab_beteiligten` beteiligte
  Komponenten oder nicht-triviale Vererbungs-/Abhängigkeitscluster.
- Zustandsdiagramm (`.dot`): Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Die Entscheidung („warum dieses Diagramm, warum diese Form“), etwaige
Annahmen und das Denk-Transkript zur Quellenerstellung gehören in die Trace
unter `diagramme["<quellpfad>"]` — nicht ins HTML. Diagrammquellen liegen als
`<fragment-stem>.<diag-id>.dot|.seq.json` neben dem Fragment (inline) bzw.
unter `diagrams/` (seitenweite Diagramme); gerendert wird mit
`render_diagrams.py`. Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert.

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n1 Introduction and functional overview\nThis software specification contains the functional description and interfaces of the\nfunctional cluster\nUpdate and Configuration Management\nwhich belongs to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nServices.\nUpdate and Configuration Man-\nagement\nhas the responsibility of installing, updating and removing software on an\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nin a safe and secure way while not sacrificing the\ndynamic nature of the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n.\nThe\nUpdate and Configuration Management\nfunctional cluster is responsible\nfor:\n•\nVersion reporting of the software present in the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n•\nReceiving and buffering software updates\n•\nChecking that enough resources are available to ensure a software update\n•\nPerforming software updates and providing log messages and progress informa-\ntion\n•\nValidating the outcome of a software update\n•\nProviding rollback functionality to restore a known functional state in case of fail-\nure\nIn addition to updating and changing software on the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Plat-\nform\n, the\nUpdate and Configuration Management\nis also responsible for up-\ndates and changes to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nitself, including all func-\ntional clusters, the underlying POSIX OS and its kernel with the responsibilities defined\nabove.\nIn order to allow flexibility in how\nUpdate and Configuration Management\nis\nused, it will expose its functionality via ara::com service interfaces, not direct APIs.\nThis ensures that the user of the functional cluster\nUpdate and Configuration\nManagement\ndoes not have to be located on the same ECU.\n8 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

    {

    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P26_48",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00191",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 26,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.1: State Machine for a\nSoftware Cluster\nThe state machine in Fig. 7.1 describes the life-cycle states of a\nSoftware Cluster\n.\nThese states are reported with\nGetSwClusterChangeInfo\nmethod.\n[SWS_UCM_00191]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkAdded\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkAdded\nafter the\nSoftware Cluster\nis successfully pro-\ncessed with\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call on the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Plat-\nform\nand if it was not previously present in the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nand\nbefore activation is finished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00192]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkAdded\nto\nkPresent\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall change from\nkAdded\nto\nkPre-\nsent\nafter a successful activation of a newly added\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00195]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkUpdated\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkUpdated\nafter a successful processing of the updated\nSoft-\nware Cluster\nwith\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call and before activation is fin-\nished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00193]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkUp-\ndated\nto\nkPresent\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall change from\nkUpdated\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful activation of the updated\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call, or after reverting the\nSoftware Cluster\nupdate with a\nRe-\nvertProcessedSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n26 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P27_49",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00196",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 27,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00196]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state\nkRemoved\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall be\nkRemoved\nafter successful completion of method\nProcessS-\nwPackage\nwhich involves the removal of the existed\nSoftware Cluster\nand before\nactivation is finished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00194]\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkRe-\nmoved\nto\nkPresent\nin case of\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware\nCluster\nstate shall change from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful call to\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod in case the\nSoftware Cluster\nwas pre-\nviously requested to be removed by\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00286]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state transition from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nin case of\nFinish\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nstate shall\nchange from\nkRemoved\nto\nkPresent\nafter a successful call to\nFinish\nmethod in case\na\nSoftware Cluster\nbeing removed has to be rolled back after a failing activation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00197] End of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from state\nkAdded\nin case of\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end of its life-cycle from\nkAdded\nafter a successful removal of a\nnewly added\nSoftware Cluster\nwith\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod call\nin case the\nSoftware Cluster\nwas previously requested to be added by\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00287]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEnd of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from\nstate\nkAdded\nin case of\nFinish\ncall\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end\nof its life-cycle from\nkAdded\nafter a successful removal of a newly added\nSoftware\nCluster\nwith\nFinish\nmethod call in case the newly added\nSoftware Cluster\nhas\nto be rolled back after a failing activation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00198] End of\nSoftware Cluster\nlife-cycle state from state\nkRe-\nmoved\n⌈\nA\nSoftware Cluster\nshall reach the end of its life-cycle if it is successfully\nremoved with a\nFinish\nmethod call and the\nSoftware Cluster\nis in state\nkRe-\nmoved\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00199] Reporting of\nSoftware Cluster\nreaching end of life-cycle\n⌈\nAny\nSoftware Cluster\nreaching the end of its life-cycle shall not be reported by\nUCM\nany more.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n7.1.2 Technical Overview\nOne of the declared goals of\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nis the ability to flexibly\nupdate the software and its configuration through over-the-air updates. During the life-\ncycle of an\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n,\nUCM\nis responsible to perform software\nmodifications on the machine and to retain consistency of the whole system.\n27 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n•\nSoftware Package\ntransfer: A phase in which, one or several\nSoftware\nPackages\nare transferred from the\nUCM\n's Client Application to the internal buffer\nof the\nUCM\n. For further information see chapter 7.1.3.\n•\nSoftware Package\nprocessing: A phase in which the\nUCM\nperforms the oper-\nation (\nkInstall\n,\nkUpdate\n,\nkRemove\n) on the relevant\nSoftwareCluster\n. For\nfurther information see chapter 7.1.5.\n•\nActivation: A phase in which the\nUCM\nchecks the dependencies of the\nSoft-\nwareCluster\ns that have been involved in the operation, then activates them\nand finally check that all the\nSoftwareCluster\ns can be executed properly (via\nState Management\n) prior to finishing the update. For further information see\nchapter 7.1.6\n7.1.2.1.1 Software Package\n[SWS_UCM_00122]\nSoftware Package\nutilization\n⌈\nThe unit for deployment that\nthe\nUCM\nshall take as input is called\nSoftware Package\n, see [1]. Each\nSoftware\nPackage\nshall address a single\nSoftwareCluster\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\nA\nSoftwareCluster\ncan act in two roles:\n•\n`Sub'-\nSoftwareCluster\n: It is a\nSoftwareCluster\nwithout diagnostic target\naddress, containing processes, executables and further elements\n•\n`Root'-\nSoftwareCluster\n: It is a\nSoftwareCluster\nwith a diagnostic target\naddress that may reference several other `Sub'-\nSoftwareCluster\ns, which thus\nform a logical group.\nA\nSoftwareCluster\ncan be of the following categories expressed by the attribute\nSoftwareCluster\n.\ncategory\n:\n•\nAPPLICATION_LAYER\n: the\nSoftwareCluster\ncan be removed by UCM\n•\nPLATFORM_CORE\n: the\nSoftwareCluster\ncannot be removed as it would break\nthe system.\n•\nPLATFORM\n: the\nSoftwareCluster\nis part of the platform software and can be\nremoved\n[SWS_UCM_00245]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Cluster category\n⌈\nUCM\nshall not remove a\nSoftwareCluster\nthat has category set to\nPLATFORM_CORE\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00028,\nRS_UCM_00029)\nA\nSoftware Package\nhas to be modelled as a so-called\nSoftwareCluster\nwhich\ndescribes the content of a\nSoftware Package\nthat is downloaded or uploaded to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n, see [9].\nThe term\nSoftware Package\nis used for the \"physical\", uploadable\nSoftware\nPackage\nthat is processed by\nUCM\nwhereas the term\nSoftwareCluster\nis used\n29 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },

      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00012",

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nfor the modeling element. In the model, the content of a\nSoftwareCluster\nis de-\nfine by references to all required model elements. The\nSoftwareCluster\nand the\nrelated model elements define the content of the manifest that is part of the\nSoftware\nPackage\n. The\nSoftware Package\nformat and the update scope are described in\nchapter \"Content of a\nSoftware Package\n\" as well as in [10].\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00012]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng ⌈\nThe\nSoftwareCluster\naggregation of\nArtifactChecksum\nshall not include the uri of this same\nSoftwareCluster\nmani-\nfest.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\nThe uri attribute in\nArtifactChecksum\nis referring to the artifact contained in the\nSoftwareCluster\n.\n7.1.2.1.2 Content of a Software Package\nEach\nSoftware Package\naddresses a single\nSoftwareCluster\nand contains\nmanifests, executables and further data (depending on the role of the\nSoftwareClus-\nter\n) as the example sketched in Figure 7.3."

    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P31_52",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00112",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 31,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nconfiguration and calibration data to be deployed on the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Plat-\nform\n. An exemplary implementation of the adaptive workflow with\nSoftware Pack-\nages\ncan be seen in chapter Methodology and Manifest in [10]. For more details on\nthe\nSoftware Package\nclass, you can refer to\nSoftwarePackage\n[SWS_UCM_00112]\nSoftware Cluster\nand version\n⌈\nSoftwareCluster\n's mani-\nfest shall include a name and a version following description of\nStrongRevisionLa-\nbelString\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00001]\n⌈\nIf any content (for instance an executable or persis-\ntent data) of an already installed\nSoftwareCluster\nis modified by an incoming\nSoftware Package\n, then the version number of the incoming\nSoftwareCluster\nindicated in the\nSoftware Package\nshall be higher than the version number of the al-\nready installed\nSoftwareCluster\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002, RS_UCM_00010, RS_UCM_-\n00011)\nIf the constraint is violated, an error will be raised according to [SWS_UCM_00103].\nA higher version number is achieved by an increment of the MajorVersion, the Mi-\nnorVersion, or the PatchVersion.\nIf there is a need to downgrade a failing\nSoftwareCluster\n(for instance, malfunction\nin the field that was not detected at activation), it will therefore be needed to repackage\nthe same old\nSoftwareCluster\nthat was properly working with an higher version\nnumber.\n[SWS_UCM_00190] Reinstallation of older\nSoftware Cluster\nversion than pre-\nviously removed\n⌈\nNew\nSoftware Cluster\ns getting installed shall be compared\nwith the history of all installed\nSoftware Cluster\ns to prevent installation of a\nSoft-\nware Cluster\nwith a lower or equal version than previously installed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00003, RS_UCM_00031)\n[SWS_UCM_00130]\nSoftware Cluster\nand version error\n⌈\nIf\nSoftwareClus-\nter\n's manifest does not contain any\nSoftwareCluster\n.\nversion\nfollowing descrip-\ntion of\nStrongRevisionLabelString\n,\nUCM\nshall raise the\nApplicationError\nInvalidPackageManifest\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00014]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Package and Software Clus-\nter shortNames\n⌈\nSoftwarePackage\nand the referenced\nSoftwareCluster\nshall\nshare the same\nshortName\nin order to be able to compare their versions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00033)\n7.1.2.1.3 Applications Persisted Data\nUpdating and rolling back of persisted data is handled completely by the application\nusing persistency without involvement of\nUCM\n. A detailed explanation can be found in\nthe Persistency Specification [11]. An exception here is the removal of persistent data\nafter a\nSoftwareCluster\nis removed.\n31 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P32_53",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00184",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 32,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00184]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPersistent data clean-up after Software Cluster re-\nmoval\n⌈\nUCM\nshall remove persistent data of a removed\nSoftwareCluster\nby ag-\ngregating the information given in the application manifest, namely PersistencyKeyVal-\nueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the\nAUTOSAR Adap-\ntive Platform\nand the file system clean.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_00017,\nRS_UCM_00004)\nFor more details, please refer to [SWS_PER_00397] in Persistency Specification [11].\n[SWS_UCM_00273]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPersistent data clean-up after Software Cluster up-\ndate that removes a process\n⌈\nUCM\nshall remove persistent data of a removed pro-\ncess by aggregating the information given in the execution manifest, namely Per-\nsistencyKeyValueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nand the file system clean.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_-\nUCM_00017, RS_UCM_00004)\nPersistent data can include administrative and backup data.\n7.1.2.2 Runtime dependencies\nProcesses within a\nSoftwareCluster\ncan have functional dependencies toward\nother\nSoftwareCluster\ns.\nDependencies are described in the\nSoftwareCluster\nmetamodel, see [9].\n[SWS_UCM_00120]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRuntime dependencies check\n⌈\nUCM\nshall check run-\ntime dependencies before the activation of the new software version. This action is\ndone in the context of\nActivate\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\nThe rationale is, if\nUCM\nhas to process several\nSoftware Packages\n, then execu-\ntion dependencies may not be fulfilled at all times during the\nSoftware Packages\nprocess but must be fulfilled before changes can be activated.\n7.1.2.3 Update scope and State Management\nSoftware Package\nprocessed by\nUCM\ncan contain\nAdaptive Applications\n, up-\ndates to\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nitself or to the underlying OS. Update type\ndepends on the content of the\nSoftware Package\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00099]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate of\nAdaptive Application\n⌈\nUCM\nshall be\nable to update\nAdaptive Applications\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001)\n[SWS_UCM_00100]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate of\nFunctional Clusters\n⌈\nUCM\nshall be\nable to update all\nFunctional Clusters\n, including\nUCM\nitself.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00028)\n[SWS_UCM_00101]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate of Host\n⌈\nUCM\nshall be able to update the un-\nderlying OS hosting the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00029)\n32 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P33_54",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00257",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 33,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nDefinition of an updatable state with respect to the system setup is the OEM respon-\nsibility. Based on the system setup and the application, the system might need to be\nswitched into a predefined state, to free resource to speed up the update, to block nor-\nmal usage of software which might cause interruptions to update process and to block\nusing functionality which might be interrupted by the update sequence.\n[SWS_UCM_00257]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate session\n⌈\nTo confirm the system is in an up-\ndatable state,\nUCM\nshall start an update session by calling\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod after its de-\npendency check triggered by\nActivate\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_-\n00003)\n[SWS_UCM_00258]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate session rejected\n⌈\nIf\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod call raises er-\nror\nkRejected\n,\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates and\nAc-\ntivate\nmethod call shall return\nApplicationError UpdateSessionRejected\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026, RS_UCM_00024)\nIf update session could be recurrently rejected, it is up to implementer to cache the\ndependency check result in order to avoid unnecessary computation and compute it\nonly once.\nDuring the update session, the minimum applications required for the Update process\nshould be executed. This way system is more robust, more resources are free and\nuser is blocked from using applications, of which failure could cause safety risk to the\nuser.\nUpdate of some components require a Machine reset to be performed. These com-\nponents should be configured to be part of\nFunction Group MachineFG\n, as the\nupdate sequence of\nFunction Group MachineFG\nincludes a\nMachine\nreset.\nEx-\necution Management\n,\nState Management\n,\nCommunication Management\nand\nUCM\nitself are good examples which probably require a Machine reset to activate the up-\ndate. Other such components could be applications involved in the update sequence\nor applications involved in safety monitoring. Further details on\nFunction Group\nMachineFG\ncan be found in\nState Management\n.\n7.1.3 Transferring Software Packages\nTo speed up the overall data transmission time, the package transfer is decoupled\nfrom the processing and activation process. This section describes requirements for\ninitiation of a data transfer, the data transmission and ending of the data transmission.\nEach\nSoftware Package\ngets its own state as soon as it is being transferred to\nUCM\n.\nThe state machines in Fig. 7.4 specify the lifecycle of a\nSoftware Package\nthat is\ntransferred to and processed by\nUCM\n. During this lifecycle, a\nSoftware Package\nis\nuniquely identified with an\nid\nthat\nUCM\nprovides to the client.\n33 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P34_55",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00007",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 34,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.4: State Machine representing\nSoftware Packages\nlifecycle\n[SWS_UCM_00007] Data transfer at any time\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide support to trans-\nfer\nSoftware Packages\nat any time when\nUCM\nis running. Transferring is decou-\npled from the\nUCM\nPackage Management states.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019,\nRS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00272]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransfer block size\n⌈\nTransferStart\nshall return\nBlockSize\nparameter to indicate the maximum block size to be allowed to transfer\nin one\nTransferData\nmethod call.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00025)\nThe block size should be aligned to flashing capability in case of Classic Platform\ncapability for instance.\n34 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P35_56",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00088",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 35,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00088] Preparation of data transfer\n⌈\nData transfer shall be prepared\nwith the method\nTransferStart\n. In the preparation step the number of bytes to\nbe transferred is provided by the client and\nUCM\nassigns an\nid\nfor the\nSoftware\nPackage\nto be transferred.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\nWhile a\nSoftware Package\nis being transferred, if\nUCM\nreceives a subsequent\nTransferStart\ncall targeting another\nSoftware Package\n,\nUCM\nshould make sure\nthat the sum of the size of both\nSoftware Package\ns (the one being transferred and\nthe one requested to be transferred) does not exceed the size of the\nUCM\nbuffer. Oth-\nerwise, the\nTransferStart\nshould raise the\nApplicationError Insufficient-\nMemory\nand the newly requested transmission should be rejected as described above.\n[SWS_UCM_00008] Executing the data transfer\n⌈\nAfter preparing of the data transfer,\nthe transmission of the\nSoftware Package\nblock-wise shall be supported by the\nmethod\nTransferData\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00145] Sequential order of data transfer\n⌈\nThe method\nTransfer-\nData\nshall support the parameter\nblockCounter\nthat shall start with 0x01 and be\nincremented by one for each subsequent block.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019,\nRS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00010] End of data transfer\n⌈\nAfter transmission of a\nSoftware Pack-\nage\nis completed, the transmission can be finished with method\nTransferExit\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00028]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSoftware Package\nAuthentication\n⌈\nUCM\nshall\ncheck authentication of the\nSoftware Package\nor the transferred block before pro-\ncessing it.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00006)\nSoftware Package\ncontains authentication and integrity tags, which are used during\nthe transfer sequence to authenticate the content of the\nSoftware Package\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00075] Multiple data transfers in parallel\n⌈\nHandling of multiple data\ntransfers in parallel shall be supported by\nUCM\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\nIf\nUCM\nprovide enough buffering resources for\nSoftware Packages\n, several pack-\nages could be transferred (in parallel) before they are processed one after the other.\nThe processing (i.e. unpacking and actually applying changes to the\nAUTOSAR Adap-\ntive Platform\n) of\nSoftware Packages\ndescribed by the state\nkProcessing\nis\nfurther detailed in Sect. 7.1.5.\n[SWS_UCM_00021] Deleting transferred\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide\na method\nDeleteTransfer\nthat shall delete the targeted\nSoftware Package\nand\nfree the resources reserved to store that\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00018)\n[SWS_UCM_00069] Report information on\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall pro-\nvide a method\nGetSwPackages\nof the interface service\nPackageManagement\nto\nprovide the\nSoftware Packages\n' identifiers, names, versions, states, consecutive\nbytes received and consecutive blocks received.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00010)\n35 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P36_57",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00216",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 36,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nIf\nSoftware Package\nis in\nkTransferring\nstate, it is not possible to get versions\nor names as manifest could not be complete or accessible, therefore method\nGetSw-\nPackages\nshould return empty values except for TransferID, ConsecutiveBytesRe-\nceived and ConsecutiveBlocksReceived at this particular state.\n[SWS_UCM_00216] Validity of TransferId\n⌈\nThe TransferId of a\nSoftware Package\nshall be invalidated for further use when it reaches final lifecycle state.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00019)\n7.1.3.1 Error handling in TransferStart\nTransferStart\nallocates resources for the client transfer.\n[SWS_UCM_00140]\nUCM\ninsufficient memory\n⌈\nTransferStart\nmethod shall raise\nthe\nApplicationError InsufficientMemory\nif the\nUCM\nbuffer has not enough\nresources to store the corresponding\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_-\nUCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\n7.1.3.2 Error handling in TransferData\nTransferData\nexecutes the following checks. It is recommended to follow the speci-\nfied order.\n[SWS_UCM_00275]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransferData\nerror handling order\n⌈\nTransfer-\nData\nmethod shall check the following error conditions and return the respective error\ncode.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00208]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00203]\n3. [SWS_UCM_00204]\n4. [SWS_UCM_00243]\n5. [SWS_UCM_00205]\n6. [SWS_UCM_00206]\n7. [SWS_UCM_00289]\n8. [SWS_UCM_00207]\n9. [SWS_UCM_00098]\n10. [SWS_UCM_00209]\n11. [SWS_UCM_00103]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\n36 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P37_58",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00208",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 37,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00208]\nTransferData\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nCalling TransferData\nafter calling\nTransferExit\nfor a specific TransferId shall raise the error\nApplica-\ntionError OperationNotPermitted\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\n[SWS_UCM_00203]\nTransferData\nInvalidTransferId\n⌈\nTransferData shall raise the\nerror\nApplicationError InvalidTransferId\nin case an invalid TransferId (An ID\nthat was not initiated by TransferStart or marked invalid by DeleteTransfer or Revert-\nProcessedSwPackages) is sent by the client.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\n[SWS_UCM_00204]\nTransferData\nIncorrectBlock\n⌈\nTransferData shall raise\nAp-\nplicationError IncorrectBlock\nupon receipt of a block counter value that is\nsuccessfully transmitted to\nUCM\nbefore or upon receipt of an unexpected block counter\nvalue.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00014, RS_UCM_00019)\n[SWS_UCM_00243] Too big block size received by UCM\n⌈\nIn the case the received\nblock size with\nTransferData\nexceeds the block size returned by\nTransferStart\nfor the same TransferId,\nUCM\nshall raise the\nApplicationError IncorrectBlock-\nSize\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00014, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00205]\nTransferData\nIncorrectSize\n⌈\nIn case the transferred Software\npackage size exceeds the provided size in\nTransferStart\n, TransferData shall raise\nApplicationError IncorrectSize\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00014, RS_UCM_00019)\n[SWS_UCM_00206]\nTransferData\nInsufficientMemory\n⌈\nTransferData shall raise\nthe       "source_page": 39,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nintegrity check\nfails. This Software Package integrity check may be realized by\nthe\nUCM\nvia a Software Package Checksum check or via other mechanisms.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\nTransferExit\nchecks the package version format in accordance to\n[SWS_UCM_00161] (\nIncompatiblePackageVersion\n).\n[SWS_UCM_00213]\nTransferExit InvalidPackageManifest\n⌈\nTransferExit\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError InvalidPackageManifest\nupon receival\nof an invalid manifest.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\nTransferExit\nchecks if the\nSoftware Cluster\nversion being updated is older\nthan currently present in\nMachine\nin accordance to [SWS_UCM_00103] (\nOldVer-\nsion\n).\n7.1.3.4 Error handling in DeleteTransfer\n[SWS_UCM_00283]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nDeleteTransfer\nerror handling order\n⌈\nDelete-\nTransfer\nmethod shall check the following error conditions and return the respective\nerror code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00214]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00215]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_00025)\nDeleteTransfer\nchecks if the supplied parameter TransferId is valid.\n[SWS_UCM_00214]\nDeleteTransfer\nInvalidTransferId\n⌈\nDeleteTransfer\nshall\nraise the error\nApplicationError InvalidTransferId\nin case an invalid Trans-\nferId is sent by the client.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\n[SWS_UCM_00215]\nDeleteTransfer\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nCalling\nDelete-\nTransfer\nduring processing or during the processing stream shall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00019)\n7.1.4 Processing of Software Packages from a stream\nIt is also possible to process a\nSoftware Package\nwhile the transfer is still ongoing.\nThe following requirements apply for this use case.\n[SWS_UCM_00165] Processing from stream\n⌈\nThe UCM may support calling\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\ndirectly from stream without waiting to receive the\nSoftware\nPackage\ncompletely.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00003, RS_UCM_00004, RS_-\nUCM_00025)\n39 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P40_61",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00166",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 40,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00166] Processing from stream state\n⌈\nIf UCM supports processing\nfrom stream and is in state\nkIdle\nor\nkReady\n, the method\nProcessSwPackage\nfor a\nSoftware Package\nin state\nkTransferring\nshall set this\nSoftware Package\nto\nstate\nkProcessingStream\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00167]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancelling streamed packages\n⌈\nAll temporary and\nprocessed data of a\nSoftware Package\nin state\nkProcessingStream\nshall be re-\nmoved if\nCancel\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00168] Transferring while processing from stream\n⌈\nSoftware\nPackage\nstate shall remain in\nkProcessingStream\nwhen\nTransferData\nis\ncalled.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00169] Finishing transfer while processing from stream\n⌈\nSoftware\nPackage\nstate shall be set to\nkProcessed\nwhen\nTransferExit\nis called and the\nSoftware Package\nis completely processed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00200]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nFailing authentication\n⌈\nUCM\nshall delete the\nSoft-\nware Package\nand its related data processed by\nProcessSwPackage\ncall if authen-\ntication is failing at\nTransferExit\nor\nProcessSwPackage\ncall.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039,\nRS_UCM_00006)\n7.1.5 Processing Software Packages\nIn contrast to package transmission, only one\nSoftware Package\ncan be processed\nat the same time to ensure consistency of the system. In the following, a software\nor package processing can involve any combination of an installation, update or re-\nmoval of applications, configuration data, calibration data or manifests. It is up to the\nvendor-specific metadata inside a\nSoftware Package\nto describe the tasks\nUCM\nhas\nto perform for its processing. For a removal, this might involve metadata describing\nwhich data needs to be deleted. Nevertheless, the communication sequence between\nthe triggering application of the software modification and\nUCM\nis the same in any case.\nFor an update of an existing application, the\nSoftware Package\ncan contain only\npartial data, e.g. just an updated version of the execution manifest. Any\nUCM\nClient\nneed to confirm that\nUCM\nis in\nkIdle CurrentStatus\nstate before starting any up-\ndate (process/activate).\n[SWS_UCM_00001] Starting the package processing\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nProcessSwPackage\nto process transferred\nSoftware Package\n.\nid\ncorresponding\nto\nSoftware Package\nshall be provided for this method.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_-\nUCM_00004, RS_UCM_00005)\n[SWS_UCM_00137] Processing several update\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall\nsupport processing of several\nSoftware Packages\n, not in parallel, by calling\nmethod\nProcessSwPackage\nseveral times in sequence.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_-\nUCM_00004, RS_UCM_00005)\nDuring package processing, the progress is provided.\n40 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P41_62",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00018",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 41,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00018] Providing Progress Information\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nGetSwProcessProgress\nto query the progress of executing the\nProcessSwPack-\nage\nmethod call for provided TransferId. Parameter\nprogress\nshall be set to a value\nrepresenting the progress between 0% and 100% (0x00 ... 0x64).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00023)\n[SWS_UCM_00003] Cancelling the package processing\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a\nmethod\nCancel\nto cancel the running package processing.\nUCM\nshall then abort the\ncurrent package processing task, undo any changes and free any reserved resources.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00024] Revert all processed\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall pro-\nvide a method\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nto revert all changes done with\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008)\nThe main difference between a\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nand a\nRollback\nis\nthat the former can only be performed before the successful activation of the targeted\nSoftware Package\n(s) while the latter can only be performed after such activation.\nDepending on the capabilities of\nUCM\nand of the updated target,\nRevertPro-\ncessedSwPackages\nis used to revert all the changes that have been applied by\nProcessSwPackage\n.\nCancel\nis also used to revert the changes of the\nSoftware\nPackage\nfor which processing started by\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod call and iden-\ntified by TransferId. For example, if an application with large resource files is updated\nin place (i.e. in the same partition) then it might not be feasible to revert the update. In\nthis case, to perform a rollback the triggering application could download a\nSoftware\nPackage\nto restore a stable version of the application.\n7.1.5.1 Error handling during Processing Software Packages\n[SWS_UCM_00277]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nProcessSwPackage\nerror handling order\n⌈\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\nmethod shall check the following error conditions and return the re-\nspective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00219]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00017]\n3. [SWS_UCM_00218]\n4. [SWS_UCM_00098]\n5. [SWS_UCM_00161]\n6. [SWS_UCM_00029]\n7. [SWS_UCM_00285]\n8. [SWS_UCM_00231]\n9. [SWS_UCM_00217]\n41 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n10. [SWS_UCM_00267]\n11. [SWS_UCM_00104]\n12. [SWS_UCM_00103]\n13. [SWS_UCM_00150]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00219]\nProcessSwPackage\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nProcessSw-\nPackage\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin\ncase the processing of the specified\nSoftware Package\nis already done, or in case\nthe processed\nSoftware Package\naction is update or removal of a non-existing soft-\nware cluster or in case streaming is not possible.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00025, RS_UCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00017] Sequential\nSoftware Package\nProcessing\n⌈\nOnce method\nProcessSwPackage\nhas been called by a client, further calls to the same method\nshall be rejected with\nApplicationError ServiceBusy\nas long as\nCurrentSta-\ntus\nis different than\nkProcessing\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00003, RS_UCM_-\n00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00218]\nProcessSwPackage\nInvalidTransferId\n⌈\nProcessSwPackage\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError InvalidTransferId\nin case an invalid\nTransferId is sent by the client.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\nProcessSwPackage\nchecks authentication in accordance to [SWS_UCM_00098] (\nAuthenticationFailed\n)\n[SWS_UCM_00161] Check Software Package version compatibility against\nUCM\nversion\n⌈\nAt ProcessSwPackage, TransferData or TransferExit calls, UCM shall raise\nApplicationError IncompatiblePackageVersion\nif the version for the\nSoft-\nware Package\ntransferred or to be processed expressed by\nminimumSupporte-\ndUcmVersion\nattribute is higher than the current version of\nUCM\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\nThe\nSoftware Package\nis generated by a tooling including a packager which version\ncould not match with the\nUCM\nversion, leading to manifest interpretation issues for\ninstance.\n[SWS_UCM_00029] Consistency Check of Manifest\n⌈\nUCM\nshall validate the content\nof the manifest against the schema defined for the meta-data(eg: for missing parameter\nor for value out of range of the parameter) and shall raise the\nApplicationError\nInvalidPackageManifest\nif it finds discrepancies there.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\n[SWS_UCM_00285]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRemoving or updating a\nSoftware Cluster\nnot\nexisting in the\nMachine\n⌈\nIf a\nSoftware Package\n's action is to remove or update\na\nSoftware Cluster\nthat is not existing in the\nMachine\n,\nUCM\nshall raise\nAppli-\ncationError SoftwareClusterMissing\nwhen\nProcessSwPackage\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00015)\n42 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P43_64",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00231",

      "source_page": 43,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00231]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nProcessSwPackage\nIncompatibleDelta\n⌈\nProcessSwPackage shall raise the error\nApplicationError Incompati-\nbleDelta\nif delta package dependency fails at processing.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\n[SWS_UCM_00217]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nProcessSwPackage\nInsufficientMemory\n⌈\nPro-\ncessSwPackage\nmethod shall raise the\nApplicationError InsufficientMem-\nory\nif the UCM buffer has not enough resources to process the corresponding\nSoft-\nware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00025)\n[SWS_UCM_00267]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nError when checksum is not recognised at process-\ning time\n⌈\nIf checksum attribute of\nArtifactChecksum\nor CryptoProvider are not\nrecognised,\nUCM\nshall raise the\nApplicationError InvalidChecksumDescrip-\ntion\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\n[SWS_UCM_00104] Integrity Check of processed Package\n⌈\nUCM\nshall raise the\nAp-\nplicationError ProcessedSoftwarePackageInconsistent\nif integrity check\nof the processed\nSoftware Packages\nfails.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\nThis operation is realized by the\nUCM\nto verify that it did not corrupt any files during the\nprocessing. This\nintegrity check\nis vendor specific and may be realized by the\nUCM\nby checking the payload Checksum or by any other mechanisms\nProcessSwPackage\nchecks if the\nSoftware Cluster\nversion being updated is\nolder than currently present in\nMachine\nin accordance to [SWS_UCM_00103] (\nOld-\nVersion\n).\n[SWS_UCM_00150] Cancellation of a Software Package processing\n⌈\nProcessS-\nwPackage\nmethod shall raise the\nApplicationError ProcessSwPackageCan-\ncelled\nif the\nCancel\nmethod has been called during the processing of a\nSoftware\nPackage\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n7.1.5.2 Error handling for Cancel\n[SWS_UCM_00278]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancel\nerror handling order\n⌈\nCancel\nmethod shall\ncheck the following error conditions and return the respective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00234]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00235]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00234]\nCancel\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nCancel shall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case the targeted\nSoftware\nPackage\nprocessing has not yet started or has been already finished.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00235]\nCancel\nInvalidTransferId\n⌈\nCancel shall raise the error\nAppli-\ncationError InvalidTransferId\nin case an invalid TransferId is sent by the\nclient.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n43 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "source_page": 44,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.1.5.3 Error handling for RevertProcessedSwPackages\n[SWS_UCM_00279]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nerror handling or-\nder\n⌈\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod shall check the following error condi-\ntions and return the respective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00237]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00236]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00237]\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nmethod call shall raise the error\nApplication-\nError OperationNotPermitted\nin case the processed\nSoftware Package\ns are\nsuccessfully activated or it is called at other states than\nkReady\n(\nSoftware Pack-\nage\n(s) are finished being processed) or\nkProcessing\nstates.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00236]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nNotAbleToRevert-\nPackages\n⌈\nRevertProcessedSwPackages\nshall raise the error\nApplication-\nError NotAbleToRevertPackages\nin case reverting of processed\nSoftware\nPackage\ns have failed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n7.1.5.4 Error handling for GetSwProcessProgress\n[SWS_UCM_00220]\nGetSwProcessProgress\nInvalidTransferId\n⌈\nGetSwPro-\ncessProgress\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError InvalidTransferId\nin\ncase an invalid TransferId is sent by the client.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00023)\n7.1.6 Activation and Rollback\nUCM\nshould notify the activation or rollback of\nSoftware Packages\nto other\nFunc-\ntional Clusters\nof the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n. Vendor specific solution\ndictates to which modules this information is available, in which form and if this is done\ndirectly when change is done or when change is executed.\n7.1.6.1 Activation\nThe\nSoftwareCluster\nstate\nkPresent\ndoes not express whether a\nSoft-\nwareCluster\nis currently executed or not. You can refer to chapter 7.1.1 Software\nCluster Lifecycle for more details about\nkPresent\nstate and sequence diagram 10.4\nfor more details about activation.\n44 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P45_66",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00107",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 45,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00107] Activated state\n⌈\nUCM\nstate\nkActivated\nshall express that new\nversion of updated\nSoftwareCluster\ns are verified.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_-\n00030)\nThe state management [3] on the level of execution is handled by the\nUCM\n's client\ncontrolling the update process.\nUCM\nhas to be able to update several\nSoftwareCluster\ns for an update campaign.\nHowever, these\nSoftwareCluster\ns could have dependencies not satisfied if updates\nare processed and activated one by one. Therefore,\nUCM\nsplits the activation action\nfrom the general package processing.\n[SWS_UCM_00027] Delta Package activation\n⌈\nApplicable version of\nSoft-\nwareCluster\non which to apply delta shall be included into related\nSoftwarePack-\nage\n's deltaPackageApplicableVersion attribute.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\n[SWS_UCM_00025] Activation of\nSoftwareCluster\ns\n⌈\nUCM\nshall offer method\nAc-\ntivate\nto enable execution of any pending changes from the previously processed\nSoftware Packages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021)\nAfter\nActivate\n, the new set of\nSoftwareCluster\ns can be started. Activation covers\nall the processed\nSoftware Packages\nfor all the clients.\n[SWS_UCM_00022] Shared Activation of\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nshall acti-\nvate all the processed\nSoftware Packages\nwhen\nActivate\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00021)\nThe activation method could lead to a full system reset. When\nSoftware Package\nupdates underlying OS,\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nor any\nAdaptive Appli-\ncation\nwhich is configured to be part of\nFunction Group MachineFG\n, the execu-\ntion of updated software occurs through system reset by calling\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nResetMachine\nmethod. Meta-data of\nSoftware\nPackage\ndefines the activation method.\nIn principle, it is possible to activate multiple versions of the same\nSoftwareCluster\nin one activation step. This could be useful for example with delta package updates\nbut does not apply to firmware updates. The specification does not prohibit to create\nthis kind of chained updates. The decision to use chained updates should be based on\nsafety aspects and the applicability of the underlying update technology, if the update\nis for a classic or an adaptive platform, if a file system is involved or if the used platform\neven support it.\n7.1.6.1.1 Error handling for\nActivate\n[SWS_UCM_00281]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nActivate\nerror handling order\n⌈\nActivate\nmethod\nshall check the following error conditions and return the respective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00241]\n45 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
