      "source_page": 46,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n2. [SWS_UCM_00026]\n3. [SWS_UCM_00258]\n4. [SWS_UCM_00242]\n5. [SWS_UCM_00280]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00241]\nActivate\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nActivate shall raise the er-\nror\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case the\nUCM\nstate is not\nkReady\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021)\n[SWS_UCM_00026] Dependency Check\n⌈\nAt activation (i.e. after\nActivate\nmethod\nis called),\nUCM\nshall perform a dependency check to ensure that all the\nSoftware\nPackages\nhaving dependencies toward each other have been processed successfully,\notherwise return\nApplicationError MissingDependencies\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007)\nIf\nActivate\nmethod cannot establish an Update Session with\nState Management\n,\nit returns\nUpdateSessionRejected\n, see [SWS_UCM_00258].\n[SWS_UCM_00242]\nActivate\nPreActivationFailed\n⌈\nActivate\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError PreActivationFailed\nin case of activation state transition\nfailure from\nState Management\nside.\n⌋\n(RS_SM_00001)\n[SWS_UCM_00280]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nActivate\nVerificationFailed\n⌈\nActivate\nshall raise\nthe error\nApplicationError VerificationFailed\nin case of verification failure\nreturned by\nState Management\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021)\n7.1.6.2 Rollback\n[SWS_UCM_00005] Rollback to the software prior to Finish the update process\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nRollback\nto recover from an activation that went wrong.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008)\nRollback can be called in the case of A/B partitions or\nUCM\nuses some other solution to\nmaintain backups of updated or removed\nSoftware Packages\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00110] Rolling-back the software update\n⌈\nAt\nkRollingBack\nstate,\nUCM\nshall disable the changes done by the software update by calling\nState Manage-\nment UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareRollback\nmethod for each\nFunc-\ntion Group\nof the processed\nSoftware Cluster\nin the update session. Then\nUCM\nshall call\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nResetMa-\nchine\nmethod if any\nSoftware Cluster\nrequires a machine reboot to be rolled\nback.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008)\n46 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P47_68",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00282",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 47,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.1.6.2.1 Error handling for\nRollback\n[SWS_UCM_00282]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRollback\nerror handling order\n⌈\nRollback\nmethod\nshall check the following error conditions and return the respective error code.\n1. [SWS_UCM_00239]\n2. [SWS_UCM_00238]\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008)\n[SWS_UCM_00239]\nRollback\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nRollback shall raise the er-\nror\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case\nUCM\ncurrent state is not\nkActivated\nnor\nkVerifying\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_00238]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRollback\nNotAbleToRollback\n⌈\nRollback shall raise\nthe error\nApplicationError NotAbleToRollback\nin case failure has occurred\nduring Rollback.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n7.1.6.3 Boot options\nDuring update process the executed software is switched from original software to\nupdated software and in case of rollback, from updated software to original version.\nWhich version of software is executed is dependent on the\nUCM\nstate and this is man-\naged by the\nUCM\n. In case of platform and OS update the switch between software\nversions occurs through system reset and depending on the system design the Exe-\ncution Management [2] might be started before\nUCM\n. In this case there can't be direct\ninterface between\nUCM\nand Execution Management [2] to define which versions of soft-\nware would be executed. Instead this would be controlled through persistent controls\nwhich are referred as\nBoot options\nin this document.\n[SWS_UCM_00094] Management of executable software\n⌈\nUCM\nshall manage which\nversion of software is available for the Execution Management [2] to launch.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00021)\nDuring the\nkActivating\nstate,\nUCM\nmodifies the\nBoot options\nso that in the next\nrestart for the updated software the new versions will be executed. In the\nkRolling-\nBack\nstate,\nUCM\nmodifies the\nBoot options\nso that in the next restart of the updated\nsoftware the original versions will be executed.\n7.1.6.4 Finishing activation\n[SWS_UCM_00020] Finishing the packages activation\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nFinish\nto commit all the changes and clean up all temporary data of the processed\nSoftware Packages.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00015)\n47 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P48_69",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00259",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 48,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nUCM\nshould also remove\nSoftware Packages\n, logs or any older versions of changed\nsoftware to save storage space. It is up to implementer to remove or not the\nSoftware\nPackages\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00259] Ending the update session\n⌈\nUCM\nshall call\nState Manage-\nment UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nStopUpdateSession\nmethod when\nUCM\nis\nexiting the\nkCleaningUp\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00021, RS_UCM_00018)\n[SWS_UCM_00240]\nFinish\nOperationNotPermitted\n⌈\nFinish shall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nin case there are no activated nor\nrolled-back\nSoftware Packages\npending finalization (i.e\nUCM\nstate is not\nkActi-\nvated\nnor\nkRolledBack\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00026)\nFor\nUCM\nto be able to free all unneeded resources while processing the\nFinish\nre-\nquest, it is up to the vendor and platform specific implementation to make sure that\nobsolete versions of changed\nSoftwareCluster\ns aren't executed anymore.\n7.1.7 Status Reporting\nOnce\nSoftware Packages\nare transferred to\nUCM\n, they are ready to be processed\nto finally apply changes to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n. In contrast to the\ntransmission, the processing and activation tasks have to happen in a strict sequential\norder.\nTo give an overview of the update sequence, the global state of\nUCM\nis described in\nthis section. The details of the processing and activation phases and the methods are\nspecified in the 7.1.5 and 7.1.6.\nThe global state of\nUCM\ncan be queried using the field\nCurrentStatus\n. The state\nmachine for\nCurrentStatus\nis shown in Fig. 7.5. This diagram does not include\nbehaviour after a reset. Examples can be found of how\nUCM\nand its\nCurrentStatus\nfield behave including reset management in chapter 10 Sequence Diagram.\n[SWS_UCM_00019] Status Field of Package Management\n⌈\nThe global state of\nUCM\nshall be provided using the field\nCurrentStatus\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n48 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P49_70",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00086",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 49,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.5: State Machine for the package processing using service interface:\nPackage-\nManagement\nUCM\nsupported method calls for each value of field\nCurrentStatus\nare shown in Fig.\n7.5.\n[SWS_UCM_00086]\n⌊\nOBSOLETE\ng\nUnsupported method calls\n⌈\nUnsupported\nmethod calls shall raise the\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00080] Idle state of Package Management\n⌈\nkIdle\nshall be the default\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00149] Return to the Idle state from Processing state\n⌈\nkIdle\nstate\nshall be set when\nProcessSwPackage\nreturns with error code\nProcessSwPackage-\nCancelled\nand if no other\nSoftware Packages\nwere previously processed during\nthis processing operation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00151] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nCancel call\n⌈\nIf\nProcessSwPackage\nhas been cancelled, it shall return error code\nProcessSwPackageCancelled\nand set state to\nkReady\nonly if at least one other\nSoftware Package\nwas previously processed during this processing operation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n49 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P50_71",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00081",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 50,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00081] Processing state of Package Management\n⌈\nkProcessing\nstate shall be set only if\nProcessSwPackage\nhas been called. This shall only be\npossible, if\nCurrentStatus\nis reported as\nkIdle\nor\nkReady\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00266]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nOperationNotPermitted error and UCM state\n⌈\nUCM\nshall return\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nif\nProcessSwPack-\nage\nis called by a client with\nUCM\nat\nCurrentStatus\nstate different than\nkIdle\n,\nkProcessing\nor\nkReady\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00001, RS_UCM_00004, RS_UCM_00005)\n[SWS_UCM_00083] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nsuccessful processing operation\n⌈\nkReady\nstate shall be set after a\nSoftware\nPackage\nprocessing has been completed successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00265]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nstate transition due to\nProcessSwPackage\nerror\n⌈\nIf\nProcessSwPackage\nraises an\nApplicationError\nother than\nProcessSwPack-\nageCancelled\n, it shall transition from\nkProcessing\nto\nkIdle\nif no other Software\nPackages were previously processed during this processing operation, or\nkReady\nif\nat least one other Software Package was previously processed before the failed pro-\ncessing operation, and shall perform clean-up actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00015, RS_UCM_-\n00026)\nClean-up actions could be similar to the cancel call by for instance deleting files, folders\nor artefacts of the processed\nSoftware Cluster\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00152] Entering the Ready state of Package Management after a\nmissing dependency\n⌈\nkReady\nstate shall be set when\nActivate\nfails due to an\nApplicationError MissingDependencies\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Management\n⌈\nkActivating\nshall be set when\nActivate\nis called. This triggers the dependency\ncheck and returns\nApplicationError MissingDependencies\nif this check fails.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00153] Action in kActivating state of Package Management\n⌈\nWhen\nkActivating\nis set and after the\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService In-\nterface\nRequestUpdateSession\nmethod call by\nUCM\n, the\nUCM\nshall call the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod for the\nconcerned\nSoftware Cluster\nincluding a list of all\nFunction Groups\nbelonging\nto that\nSoftware Cluster\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\n[SWS_UCM_00260]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPrepareUpdate, VerifyUpdate and PrepareRollback\norders\n⌈\nUCM\nshall compute the order of the\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\n,\nVerifyUpdate\nand\nPrepareRollback\nmethod\ncalls from the dependency model included in the\nSoftware Cluster\nmanifests.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00007, RS_UCM_00021, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00261] PrepareUpdate, VerifyUpdate and PrepareRollback syn-\nchronous calls\n⌈\nCalls to\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\n,\nVerifyUpdate\nand\nPrepareRollback\nmethods shall not be\nconcurrent.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n50 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P51_72",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00262",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 51,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00262]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate preparation rejected\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod call re-\nturns error\nkRejected\ntoo many times or for too long (implementation specific thresh-\nolds),\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00263] Update preparation failure\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState Man-\nagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareUpdate\nmethod returns error\nkPrepareFailed\n,\nUCM\nshall transition from\nkActivating\nto\nkReady\nstates.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00026)\n[SWS_UCM_00154]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the Verifying state of Package Manage-\nment\n⌈\nkVerifying\nshall be set when the dependency check have been performed\nsuccessfully (all dependencies are satisfied) and that the preparation of the\nSoft-\nware Clusters\nby the\nState Management\nhas been successfully performed.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\nThe machine could most likely be restarted in case a A/B partition is used. In case\nthe A/B partition is not used, all affected\nFunction Groups\nor the platform could be\nrestarted. Immediately after the processed\nSoftware Package\nhas been restarted,\na system check has to be performed in order to make sure the machine is able to start\nup as expected. With this check it is verified that other safety relevant software like\nFunctional Cluster Platform Health Manager\n[12] is running and user can\nbe protected from any issues caused by the update after the update has finished.\nAn update could most likely require to reparse the manifests after performing the\natomic activation of the\nSoftware Clusters\n(switching A/B partition, changing sym-\nlinks, etc.) if a machine reset is not needed.\n[SWS_UCM_00085]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the kActivated state of Package Manage-\nment\n⌈\nkActivated\nstate shall be set when the machine or all impacted\nFunction\nGroups\n(the ones related to the processed\nSoftware Package\n) have been suc-\ncessfully restarted and verified indicated by successful return of\nState Management\nUpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod calls.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00024)\nkVerifying\nstate gives the client controlling the update process a chance to perform\nverification test by calling\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\n[SWS_SM_91017]\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod, though functionality in verify state can\nbe limited. Client can also coordinate the results over several\nAUTOSAR Adaptive\nPlatforms\nand still perform a\nRollback\nif verification indicates the need for it.\nIf the system check is successful, the client can decide either to\nRollback\nthe current\nactive processing so that the previous processed working software gets started, or to\nperform\nFinish\nso that the changes of processed software become permanent. By\ncalling\nFinish\na clean-up is initiated and in case of A/B partition, a swap between\nthe partitions happens and the newly inactive partition becomes a copy of the newly\nactive partition. In case\nFinish\nsucceeds (including the clean-up), the current\nCur-\nrentStatus\nchanges to\nkIdle\n.\nFor\nRollback\nthe update software needs to be deactivated and possibly reactivated\nfrom original version, e.g. self-update of\nUCM\n. For this reason\nRollback\nis also\n51 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P52_73",
      "source_element": "SWS_SM_91017",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 52,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nperformed through two states, similarly as activation. Calling\nRollback\nsets\nUCM\ninto\nkRollingBack\nstate where original software version is made executable and\nwhere original software is activated by the\nState Management\n. This is started by\ncalling\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface [SWS_SM_91017]\nPrepareRollback\nmethod for each\nSoftware Cluster\n. On success,\nUCM\ngoes to\nkRollingBack\nstate. In this state all the changes introduced during update process\nhave been deactivated and can be cleaned by calling\nFinish\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00126] Entering the\nkRollingBack\nstate after a Rollback call\n⌈\nThe\nstate\nkRollingBack\nshall be set when\nRollback\nis called.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_-\nUCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00155]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the kRolling-Back state after a failure in\nthe kVerifying state\n⌈\nThe state\nkRollingBack\nshall be set if any of the\nState Man-\nagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nmethod calls returns\nthe result\nkVerifyFailed\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00264]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate verification rejected\n⌈\nIf any one of the\nState\nManagement UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nVerifyUpdate\nreturns error\nkRe-\njected\ntoo many times or for too long (implementation specific thresholds),\nUCM\nshall\ntransition to\nkRollingBack\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00030, RS_UCM_00008)\n[SWS_UCM_00111]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nEntering the\nkRollingBack\nstate\n⌈\nThe state\nkRollingBack\nshall be set after all calls to\nState Management UpdateRequest\nService Interface\nPrepareRollback\nhave returned successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008,\nRS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00146] Entering the Cleaning-up state after a Finish call\n⌈\nThe state\nkCleaningUp\nshall be set when\nFinish\nis called and the\nUCM\nstarts to perform\ncleanup actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00162] Entering the Cleaning-up state after a\nRevertProcessedSw-\nPackages\ncall\n⌈\nThe state\nkCleaningUp\nshall be set when\nRevertProcessedSw-\nPackages\nis called in\nkProcessing\nor\nkReady\nstates and the\nUCM\nstarts to perform\ncleanup actions.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00163] Action in Cleaning-up state\n⌈\nWhen\nkCleaningUp\nstate is set,\nthe\nUCM\nshall clean up all data of the processed packages that are not needed any-\nmore.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00164] Cleaning up of Software Packages\n⌈\nIn\nkCleaningUp\nstate, the\nUCM\nmay remove (from the UCM buffer for instance) the \"physical\" Software Package\n(e.g. zip file) that was used to transport the the SoftwareCluster to the\nUCM\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n[SWS_UCM_00127] Finishing update sequence\n⌈\nkIdle\nshall be set when\nFinish\nis called and the clean-up has been successfully performed. This finishes the update\nsequence and next sequence can be started.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00008, RS_UCM_00030)\n52 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P53_74",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00147",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 53,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_00147] Return to the Idle state from Cleaning-up state\n⌈\nkIdle\nstate\nshall be set when the Clean-up operation has been completed successfully.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00024)\n7.1.8 Robustness against reset\nFailure during over-the-air updates could lead into corrupted or inconsistent software\nconfiguration and further updates might be blocked. For this reason\nUCM\nneeds to be\nrobust against interruptions like power downs.\n[SWS_UCM_00157] Detection of reset\n⌈\nAt start up\nUCM\nshall identify if uncontrolled\nreset occurred.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\nThe way for\nUCM\nto detect uncontrolled reset is project specific.\nUCM\ncould use hard-\nware platform specific registers to detect Soft/Hard reset. Or it could access PHM\nFunctional Cluster to detect uncontrolled reset.\nUCM\ncould also check that the\nCur-\nrentStatus\npersistent field is not\nkIdle\nor\nkVerifying\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00158] Cleanup of interrupted actions\n⌈\nAfter an uncontrolled reset,\nUCM\nshall check non volatile memory integrity, recover processed artifacts in case it\nis corrupted and resume interrupted actions in order to return the system into a state\nfrom where\nUCM\ncan continue serving its Clients.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\n[SWS_UCM_00270]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM internal state persistency\n⌈\nUCM\nshall persist\nCurrentStatus\nstate field to be able to resume on-going update after an intended or\nunintended reboot.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00027)\n7.1.8.1 Boot monitoring\nActivation failure during OS and Platform-self updates can lead to a state in which the\nsystem is not able to reach a point where\nUCM\nand the client are able to function as\nexpected and thus not able to execute the rollback. For these cases the system should\ninclude component which is responsible to monitor that the OS and platform will start\nup correctly. In case of failure, the Boot monitoring component should trigger a reset\nor modify the boot options to trigger a rollback.\n7.1.9 History\n[SWS_UCM_00115] History\n⌈\nGetHistory\nmethod shall retrieve all actions that have\nbeen performed by\nUCM\nwithin a specific time window input parameter.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00032)\n53 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P54_75",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00160",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 54,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nIn the case the\nUCM\nClient requests a rollback after a successful activation,\nCur-\nrentStatus\nfield transitioning to\nkActivated\n,\nGetHistory\nmethod will later re-\nturn\nGetHistoryType\n, with subelement\nResolution\nof type\nResultType\nequal to\nkActivatedAndRolledBack\n.\n[SWS_UCM_00160] Processing results records\n⌈\nUCM\nshall save activation time and\nactivation result of processed\nSoftware Packages\nin the history.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00032)\n[SWS_UCM_00271]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nKeeping history of failure error code\n⌈\nUCM\nshall keep\nin\nGetHistoryType\nsubelement\nFailureError\nthe last failure error code as de-\nscribed in [SWS_UCM_00136]. If no error occurred, the stored value shall be 0.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00032)\n7.1.10 Version Reporting\n[SWS_UCM_00004] Report software information\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nGetSwClusterInfo\nof the interface service\nPackageManagement\nto provide the\nidentifiers and versions of the\nSoftwareCluster\ns that are in state\nkPresent\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00002)\n[SWS_UCM_00030] Report changes\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a method\nGetSwCluster-\nChangeInfo\nof the interface service\nPackageManagement\nto provide the identifiers\nand versions of the\nSoftwareCluster\nthat are in state\nkAdded\n,\nkUpdated\nor\nkRe-\nmoved\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00011)\n[SWS_UCM_00185] Provide\nSoftwareCluster\ngeneral information\n⌈\nUCM\nshall\nprovide a method\nGetSwClusterDescription\nto return the version, type approval,\nlicense and release notes of the\nSoftwareCluster\nthat are in state\nkPresent\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002, RS_UCM_00011)\n7.1.11 Securing Software Updates\nUCM\nprovides service interface using\nara::com\n. There is no authentication of the\nclient in\nUCM\n's update sequence.\nFor authentication of the\nSoftware Package\n, you can refer to 7.1.3\n[SWS_UCM_00103]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUpdate to older\nSoftware Cluster\nversion than\ncurrently present\n⌈\nIn order to avoid an attacker to install an old\nSoftware Cluster\nversion having known security flaws,\nUCM\nshall prohibit its processing. In case of such\nattempt,\nUCM TransferExit\nor\nTransferData\nshall raise the\nApplicationError\nOldVersion\n, keep within history this attempt and delete old\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00031)\n54 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P55_76",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00002",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 55,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00002]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM confidential information handling\n⌈\nThe\nPackageManagement\ninterface shall only be mapped via\nara::com\nto a se-\ncure endpoint using secure communication channel providing confidentiality protec-\ntion.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00002, RS_UCM_00010, RS_UCM_00011)\nThe GetSwClusterInfo, GetSwClusterChangeInfo, GetHistory, GetSwClusterDescrip-\ntion and GetSwPackages methods are using data that could identify vehicle user and\ntherefore should be protected for confidentiality.\n[SWS_UCM_00202]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTrusted Platform compliance\n⌈\nUCM\nshall ensure that\nafter provisioning updates, all the necessary changes to maintain the Trusted Platform\nare carried out.\n⌋\n(RS_EM_00014)\nThe authentication tag of the Trusted Platform corresponding to the updated/re-\nmoved/added executable files should also be updated/removed/added. See also Chap-\nter 7.10 of the Execution Management [2] for details on the Trusted Platform.\n7.1.12 Functional cluster lifecycle\n[SWS_UCM_00274]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM\ninitialization\n⌈\nUCM\nshall offer its services only after\nits internal initialization has been completed, after switching to Running state.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00044)\nThis requirement prevents calling\nUCM\nsubordinate API while internal initialization is\non-going. The concrete initialization tasks are implementation specific.\n7.1.12.1 Shutdown behaviour\nThere are no requirements of shutdown behaviour from\nUCM\nfunctional cluster.\n55 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P56_77",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01205",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 56,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2 UCM Master\n7.2.1 UCM Master Functional Cluster lifecycle\n[SWS_UCM_01205]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\ninternal state persistency\n⌈\nUCM Mas-\nter\nshall persist its state to be able to resume on-going update campaign after an\nintended or unintended reboot.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00042)\n[SWS_UCM_01019]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\ninitialization\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall offer\nits services only after its internal initialization has been completed, after switching to\nRunning state.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00044)\nThis requirement prevents calling\nUCM Master\nAPI while internal initialization is on-\ngoing. The concrete initialization tasks are implementation specific.\n7.2.2 Technical Overview\nUCM Master\nobjective is to provide a standard Adaptive Autosar solution to safely and\nsecurely update a complete vehicle Over The Air or by a Diagnostic Tester.\nUCM Master\nreceives packages from\nBackend\nor Diagnostic tool, parses and inter-\nprets the\nVehicle Package\n, transfers or streams\nSoftware Packages\nto suitable\ntargets (\nUCM\nsubordinate or Diagnostic Application) and orchestrates the processing,\nactivations and eventual rollbacks. All these actions are what is called a campaign\nwhich\nUCM Master\nis coordinating. The\nUCM\nof the machines in the same network of\na\nUCM Master\n, candidates target of a campaign, are referred to as\nUCM\nsubordinates."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P57_78",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01003",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 57,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nThe\nUCM Master\ncould be considered as a set of add-on features that could enrich\nany\nUCM\ninstance. Therefore, as per the\nUCM\nAPIs, the\nUCM Master\nAPIs are part of\nthe\nAdaptive Platform Services\n.\nUCM\nand\nUCM Master\nhave separate service\ninstances.\nThe\nOTA Client\nestablishes a communication between\nBackend\nand\nUCM Master\nso that they can exchange information of the installed\nSoftware Clusters\nin the\nvehicle and the\nSoftware Clusters\navailable in the\nBackend\n. This communica-\ntion could be triggered by\nOTA Client\nwith a scheduler and\nUCM Master\nto request\nthe updates in case of newly available\nSoftware Clusters\n(pull case) or by\nBack-\nend\nto push, for instance, an important security update to a fleet of vehicles (push\ncase). The computation to find new\nSoftware Clusters\nversions and resolution of\ndependencies between\nSoftware Clusters\ncan be either done at\nUCM Master\nor\nBackend\n.\nVehicle Driver interface\nAdaptive Application\nis required if it is needed during an\nupdate campaign to interact with vehicle human driver through for instance Human-\nMachine Interface. Download of packages from a\nBackend\ncould have various finan-\ncial costs for the driver depending of communication types, so consent from driver\ncould be suitable.\nVehicle State Manager Adaptive Application\nis required if it is needed dur-\ning an update campaign to control the vehicle state for safety purposes. For instance, it\ncould be required for safety to have standing still vehicle, shut-off engine, closed doors,\netc. before starting an\nUCM\nactivation or during its processing.\n7.2.3 UCM Master general behaviour\nThe\nUCM Master\nacts as a client of the service interface offered by the\nUCM\nsubor-\ndinates, already specified in\nUCM\n. However, the\nUCM Master\nalso offers three differ-\nent service interfaces to\nOTA Client\n, Vehicle Driver interface and\nVehicle State\nManager\nrespectively.\nUCM Master\naggregates\nUCM\nsubordinates states and can re-\nport its status field to a\nBackend\nthrough its\nOTA Client\n.\nA\nUCM Master\nreceives a\nVehicle Package\nand transfers or streams\nSoftware\nPackage\n(s) to the\nUCM\nsubordinates for an\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform Soft-\nware Cluster\nupdate. A\nVehicle Package\ncontains instructions for orchestrating\nupdates between\nECUs\n. The\nUCM Master\nprovides information about\nECUs\nin the\nvehicle, installed software and update campaign resolution.\n[SWS_UCM_01003]\nUCM Master\nchecks states of\nUCM\nsubordinates\n⌈\nA\nUCM\nMaster\nshall check the status of its\nUCM\nsubordinates are all at\nkIdle CurrentSta-\ntus\nstate before starting a campaign.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00043)\nUCM Master\nshould for instance make sure that there is no ongoing diagnostic up-\ndates before starting an update campaign by checking the reported state(s) of the\nUCM\nsubordinate(s) to be idle.\n57 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P58_79",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00009",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 58,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.4 UCM identification\nFor\nUCM Master\nto distribute\nSoftware Packages\nto other\nUCM\nsubordinates,\nUCM\nMaster\nhas to identify\nUCM\nsubordinates in vehicle. This identification could be at boot\nor later but at least before any communication with\nBackend\nare engaged. Each\nUCM\nhas a unique identifier in\nVehicle Package UcmModuleInstantiation\ncalled\nidentifier to help\nUCM Master\ntransferring packages to targeted\nUCM\ns. To get such\nidentifier,\nUCM Master\nwill perform first a service discovery through ara::com to get all\nUCM\ns service instances available. Then\nUCM Master\nwill call\nGetId\nmethod for each\nUCM\nsubordinates returning each corresponding\nUcmModuleInstantiation\nidenti-\nfiers.\n[SWS_UCM_00009]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM\nexposing its identifier\n⌈\nUCM\nshall provide a\nmethod\nGetId\nreturning its\nUcmModuleInstantiation\nidentifier.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00036)\nIf an\nECU\nhosting\nUCM\nsubordinate is replaced physically, it will register its services\nto the registry at boot up and\nUCM Master\nwill be able to communicate with\nUCM\nsubordinate(s).\n[SWS_UCM_01005]\nUCM Master\nis discovering\nUCM\ns in vehicle\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall continuously look for\nUCM\nservice instances (use of StartFindService() call).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00036)\nIf a\nUCM Master\nis failing, another inactive\nUCM Master\ncould be used or activated\nby\nOTA Client\n.\nDefault (at boot) Master/Subordinate hierarchy or priority could be optionally overwrit-\nten for each campaign based on\nVehicle Package\ncontent at the condition\nOTA\nClient\ncould properly parse\nVehicle Package\ns.\n7.2.5 UCM Master Software Packages transfer or streaming\nUCM Master\nhas generally same transfer API as\nUCM\nin order to simplify implementa-\ntion and reuse code as much as possible (could be shared library between\nUCM\nand\nUCM Master\n).\nIt is necessary to distinguish\nVehicle Package\n(UCM Master specific) from\nSoft-\nware Packages\ntransfer.\n[SWS_UCM_01011]\nTransferVehiclePackage\nInsufficientMemory\n⌈\nTrans-\nferVehiclePackage\nmethod shall raise the\nApplicationError Insufficient-\nMemory\nif the\nUCM\nbuffer has not enough resources to process the corresponding\nVehicle Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00013)\n[SWS_UCM_01018]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransferVehiclePackage BusyWithCampaign\n⌈\nTransferVehiclePackage\nmethod shall return the\nApplicationError Busy-\nWithCampaign\n, if the\nUCM\nClient wants to start a new campaign, while a campaign is\nalready started and active.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n58 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P59_80",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01014",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 59,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_01014] Packages transferring sequence\n⌈\nTransferStart\nmethod\nshall raise the\nApplicationError UnexpectedPackage\nif the\nSoftware Pack-\nage\nname parameter was not a value of the\nRequestedPackage\nfield.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01013] Too big block size received by\nUCM Master\n⌈\nIn the case the\nreceived block size with\nTransferData\nexceeds the block size returned by\nTrans-\nferStart\nor\nTransferVehiclePackage\nfor the same TransferId,\nUCM Master\nshall raise the\nApplicationError IncorrectBlockSize\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01015] Invalid Vehicle Package manifest\n⌈\nTransferExit\nshall raise\nthe\nApplicationError InvalidPackageManifest\nwhen a\nVehicle Package\nmanifest is not compliant with the AUTOSAR schema.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00036, RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01016] Invalid Package Manifest\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall raise the\nAppli-\ncationError InvalidPackageManifest\nin case a manifest file is not compliant\nwith the AUTOSAR schema.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00036, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01017] RequestedPackage field\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide the field\nRequestedPackage\ncontaining the requested\nSoftware Package\nname and ver-\nsion as defined in update campaign. Changing this field is a notification for the\nOTA\nClient\nto start transfer of the requested\nSoftware Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00042)\nOTA Client\ndoes not know what\nSoftware Packages\nshould be transferred in a\ngiven campaign contained in a\nVehicle Package\n.\nOTA Client\ncan know what\nSoftware Package\nis expected to be transferred by subscribing to\nUCM Master\n's\nRequestedPackage\nfield. Version is added to support campaigns which need an up-\ndate path for a\nSoftware Package\nrequiring an intermediate update to a transitional\nversion. In this case the version parameter makes it unambiguous which package\nversion shall be transferred as both have the same name assigned.\n7.2.6 Adaptive Applications interacting with UCM Master\nIn order to have interoperability between several vendors platforms,\nAdaptive Ap-\nplications\ninteracting with\nUCM Master\nvia ara::com like\nOTA Client\n,\nVehicle\nState Manager\nor Vehicle Driver Interface have their APIs specified. However, their\ndetailed behaviours are out of scope for this specification document.\n7.2.6.1 OTA Client\nOTA Client\nis an\nAdaptive Application\nthat sets communication channel be-\ntween\nBackend\nand\nUCM Master\n. The communication between\nBackend\nand\nOTA\nClient\nis abstracted and details like protocol are out of scope for this specification\ndocument.\nOTA Client\nshould make sure\nBackend\nis providing the right information\n59 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P60_81",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00075",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 60,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nand packages to the vehicle by identifying the vehicle, by for instance sending VIN to\nBackend\n.\nOTA Client\nuses the\nUCM Master\nas a service provider via ara::com. Since trans-\nferring\nVehicle Packages\nand\nSoftware Packages\nfrom\nBackend\nto\nUCM Mas-\nter\nis\nOTA Client\n's responsibility,\nOTA Client\nshould be able to accommodate any\nproprietary communication protocol used between\nOTA Client\nand\nBackend\nand\nconvert it into ara::com transport protocol.\nOTA Client\nshould support\nUCM Master\nSoftware Packages\ntransfer or streaming as specified in chapter 7.2.5, it should\nthen provide at least the following functionality:\n•\nComply to the requirements of chapter 7.1.3 in the context of package transfer\nbetween\nOTA Client\nand\nUCM Master\n.\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nRequestedPackage\nfield to\nknow what\nSoftware Package\nis expected to be transferred\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nTransferState\nfield to know\nwhat is campaign state\n•\nOTA Client\nshould subscribe to\nUCM Master\n's\nSafetyState\nfield to eventu-\nally make sure vehicle is in a safe state before transferring Packages\n•\nOTA Client\ncould support multiple data transfers in parallel, as specified in\n[SWS_UCM_00075]\nIn addition,\nOTA Client\ncould support the ability to pause or resume the package\ntransfer for the current campaign to prioritize the transfer of the packages from a dif-\nferent campaign. The ability of\nOTA Client\nto pause or resume the package transfer\nmight be helpful in the case there is a need to cancel an ongoing campaign at\nkTrans-\nferring\nstate to allow higher priority campaign to be performed.\nOnly one\nUCM Master\nhas to be used by\nOTA Client\ns per network domain. As\nUCM\nMaster\nis distributing\nSoftware Packages\nand coordinating\nUCM\nsubordinates,\nOTA\nClient\ns in the same network domain have to make sure there are no already on-going\ncampaigns when starting a new campaign with\nTransferVehiclePackage\nmethod\ncall by checking\nUCM Master\n's state with\nTransferState\nfield, in order to avoid any\ninterference and guarantee success of an update campaign.\n[SWS_UCM_01101] Provide information of installed\nSoftware Clusters\nin ve-\nhicle\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a method\nGetSwClusterInfo\nto return information\nof all\nSoftware Cluster\npresent in the vehicle.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033)\nUCM Master\ncan aggregate\nSoftware Cluster\ninformation from several\nUCM\ns\nwithin a vehicle and returns the result to a\nBackend\nwhich can compute if there is any\nnew\nSoftware Cluster\navailable and decide to send to\nUCM Master\nthrough\nOTA\nClient\na\nVehicle Package\n. It is up to\nOTA Client\nto make sure the synchroni-\nsation of the versions of\nSoftware Packages\npresent in\nBackend\nand\nSoftware\nCluster\ns in the vehicles using\nGetSwClusterInfo\nor\nSwPackageInventory\nis\nrecent enough before starting a campaign with\nTransferVehiclePackage\ncall.\n60 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P61_82",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01103",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 61,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_01103] Inform\nBackend\nof needed\nSoftware Packages\nfor an up-\ndate\n⌈\nOn\nSwPackageInventory\ncall,\nUCM Master\nshall compare the supplied list\nof available\nSoftware Packages\nin the\nBackend\nfor the vehicle to its own inter-\nnal information of present\nSoftware Cluster\ns in the vehicle and return the list of\nSoftware Packages\nselected for update.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033)\nThe\nOTA Client\nuses this returned\nSoftware Packages\nlist to re-\nquest the selected packages to the\nBackend\n. As required by constraint\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00014], each\nSoftware Cluster\ncorresponds to one\nSoftware Package\nand share the same\nshortName\n.\n[SWS_UCM_01119] Report information of\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a method\nGetSwPackages\nto return the identifiers, names, versions,\nConsecutive Bytes Received, Consecutive Blocks Received and states of\nSoftware\nPackages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n7.2.6.2 Vehicle Driver Interface\nVehicle driver interface could be required by legal constrains or communication cost\nconsideration. To support mandatory safety and security critical updates, driver inter-\naction can be used for:\n•\nRequesting transfer, processing or activation permission from vehicle driver\n•\nNotifying vehicle driver of safety and security measures he has to apply to the\nvehicle in order to proceed to next step into the update campaign\n[SWS_UCM_01105] Interaction of\nUCM Master\nwith Vehicle Driver\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a method\nDriverApproval\nin order to receive the confirmation of the\nvehicle driver's approval.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00038)\nThe Vehicle Driver Interface\nAdaptive Application\ncould adapt its notification\ncontent related to safety by subscribing to the UCM Master's\nSafetyConditions\nfield.\n[SWS_UCM_01117]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\nSafetyState\nfield\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall\nprovide to vehicle driver interface the\nSafetyConditions\nfield.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00038,\nRS_UCM_00037)\nUCM Master\ncan notify vehicle driver with\nSafetyState\nfield if the vehicle safety is\nbreached during the update, by for instance popping-up a message.\n[SWS_UCM_01118] UCM Master waiting for vehicle driver approval\n⌈\nIn the case\napproval from driver is requested as configured in\nVehiclePackage\n,\nUCM Master\nshall wait for\nDriverApproval\nmethod with parameter\nApproval\n=True before tran-\nsitioning state from\nkVehiclePackageTransferring\nto\nkSoftwarePackage_-\nTransferring\n,\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nto\nkProcessing\nor\nkPro-\ncessing\nto\nkActivating\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00038)\n61 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P62_83",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00003",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 62,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00003] Exclusive use of Vehicle Driver Interface\n⌈\nSoftware\nIntegrator shall ensure that only one\nAdaptive Application\nis using the\nUCM\nMaster\n's Vehicle Driver Interface.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\nFor example, the integrator may restrict the access of Vehicle Driver Interface from\nUCM Master\nby configuring the Identity and Access Management functional cluster\naccordingly.\n[SWS_UCM_01107]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\nprovides progress information to Ve-\nhicle Driver\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide to Vehicle Driver Interface\nAdaptive Ap-\nplication\nmethods\nGetSwTransferProgress\nand\nGetSwProcessProgress\nin\norder for\nUCM Master\nto inform progress of respectively update campaign's transfer\nand processing.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00038)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00004] Unsupported safety by Vehicle driver interface\n⌈\nIn\nthe case\nSafetyConditions\nfield is not a supported safety Vehicle driver interface,\nit shall call the method\nDriverApproval\nwith parameter\nSafetyStates\nincluding at\nleast one\nSafetyStates\n='NotSupported'.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_01120] Provide\nSoftware Packages\ngeneral information\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall provide a method\nGetSwPackageDescription\nto return the descrip-\ntion of each\nSoftware Packages\nthat are part of current campaign and that are\ncontained in\nVehicle Package\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033, RS_UCM_00038)\n[SWS_UCM_01135]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nGet Software Clusters descriptions from a vehi-\ncle\n⌈\nAt\nGetSwClusterDescription\nmethod call via\nVehicleDriverApplica-\ntion\ninterface,\nUCM Master\nshall return\nSoftware Clusters\ndescriptions ag-\ngregated from the\nUCM\nSubordinates or Flashing Adapters.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033, RS_-\nUCM_00038)\n7.2.6.3 Vehicle State Manager\nVehicle State Manager\nis collecting states from the several vehicle\nECU\ns and in-\nforms\nUCM Master\nwhen the safety state computed based on the safety policy re-\nferred in the\nVehicle Package\nis changing. If the safety policy is not met, the\nUCM\nMaster\ncan for instance decide to:\n•\nInform vehicle driver that the safety conditions are not met to continue the update\n•\npostpone, pause or cancel the update until policy is met\n[SWS_UCM_01109]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\nprovides a safety interface\n⌈\nUCM Mas-\nter\nshall provide a field\nSafetyConditions\nfor which values are available in\nVehi-\nclePackage\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_01110]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUCM Master\nSafetyState method\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a method\nSafetyState\nto get informed of vehicle state changes.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00037)\n62 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P63_84",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00005",

      "source_page": 63,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00005]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSafety state change\n⌈\nVehicle State\nManager\nAdaptive Application shall call\nSafetyState\nmethod provided by\nUCM\nMaster\nwhen the safety state is changing.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00009]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSafety condition change\n⌈\nVehicle\nState Manager\nAdaptive Application shall call\nSafetyState\nmethod provided by\nUCM Master\nwhen the field\nSafetyConditions\nis changing.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035,\nRS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00015]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTrigger on\nkVehicleChecking\nstate\n⌈\nOn\ntransition to\nkVehicleChecking\nstate,\nVehicle State Manager\nshall first per-\nform checks to assess the post-activation state of the vehicle.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nVehicle State Manager\ncould be responsible for performing post-activation\nchecks, interfacing with an application performing such checks, confirming backend\nis still reachable and further updates are still possible.\n[SWS_UCM_01272]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicleCheck\ncall not permitted\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall return\nApplicationError OperationNotPermitted\nif\nVehicleCheck\nmethod is called in another\nUCM Master\nstate than\nkVehicleChecking\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00006]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nExclusive use of Vehicle State Manager\n⌈\nSystem Integrator shall ensure that\nVehicle State Manager\nis the exclusive user\nof the\nSafetyState\nmethod.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\nFor example, the integrator may restrict the access to\nVehicle State Manager\nin\nconfiguring the Identity and Access Management functional cluster accordingly.\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00007]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUnsupported safety conditions by Vehi-\ncle State Manager\n⌈\nIn the case the requested\nSafetyConditions\nfield is not sup-\nported by\nVehicle State Manager\n, it shall call\nSafetyState\nmethod with param-\neter\nSafetyStates\nincluding at least one\nSafetyStates\n='NotSupported'.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00008]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSwitching vehicle into update mode\n⌈\nVe-\nhicle State Manager\nshall change vehicle's state and its\nECUs\nin the right update\nmode in order to avoid any timeout issues during update.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00037)\nThis vehicle state change could be triggered based on UCM Master State Machine.\n7.2.6.4 Flashing Adapter\nFlashing Adapter is an application that is used in the case\nUCM Master\nis updating a\nAUTOSAR Classic Platform\nor any platform that can be flashed using diagnostic.\nIt contains OEM specific diagnostic sequences and communicates via\nara::com\nwith\nthe\nUCM Master\nand the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n, and uses an implemen-\ntation of diagnostic protocol data unit application programming interface (\nD-PDU API\n)\nto communicate with Classic ECUs over the Vehicle Bus.\n63 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P64_85",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00011",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 64,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nThe data transfer from Flashing Adapter to the target\nECU\nvia diagnostic communi-\ncation can be subject to interruptions if communication on a higher priority protocol\noccurs, e.g. OBD services. In that case the Flashing Adapter can use a project spe-\ncific strategy to detect the interruption, retry the transfer from the beginning, and decide\nwhether to notify or not the client about the transfer interruption.\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00011]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nFlashing Adapter provided interface\n⌈\nFlashing Adapter shall provide the same\nara::com\nservice interface as\nUCM\n([SWS_UCM_00131]).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n64 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P65_86",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01121",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 65,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.7 Non Adaptive Platform update\n[SWS_UCM_01121]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nAdaptive Platform interface provided for Flashing\nAdapter\n⌈\nThe interface provided by the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nin order to\nupdate non AUTOSAR Platform should comply with ISO 22900-2:2017 (\nD-PDU API\n)\nbut as this standard's coverage is wide, it is allowed to implement a reduced API that is\nneeded to update for instance a\nAUTOSAR Classic Platform\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe implementation of the\nD-PDU API\nis processing binary data from the Flashing\nAdapter and do all of the required session, transport and network layer handling to\nsend and receive the data on the physical vehicle bus with respect to the underlying\nprotocols. The reason of using ISO 22900-2:2017 is to ensure that the specific Flashing\nAdapter from any vehicle or tool manufacturer can operate on a common software\ninterface and can easily exchange\nMVCI\n(Modular Vehicle Communication Interface)\nprotocol module implementations.\nIn the case the targeted ECU by an update does not have the capability to switch\nbetween current and new\nSoftware Cluster\n, the vehicle package campaign should\nforesee to download not only the new version but also the currently installed version\nof the Software Cluster to be updated in order to make possible a rollback from the\nnew version to the old version of the\nSoftware Cluster\n. The location to store the\ncurrent\nSoftware Package\ncould be the Flashing Adapter but ultimately it has to be\navailable to Flashing Adapter in order to flash it in case of a rollback.\n7.2.7.1 D-PDU API implementation support\n[SWS_UCM_01122]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported physical layers by\nD-PDU API\nimple-\nmentation\n⌈\nISO_11898_2_DWCAN (Dual Wire CAN), ISO_11898_3_DWFTCAN\n(Dual Wire CAN Fault tolerant), SAE_J2411_SWCAN (Single Wire CAN) and\nIEEE_802_3(Ethernet) physical layers shall be supported if their respective physical\nvehicle bus is available inside the ECU, all other physical layers present in\nD-PDU API\nare optional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01123]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported application layers by\nD-PDU API\nimple-\nmentation\n⌈\nISO_15765_3 (Unified diagnostic services, UDS on CAN, ISO withdrawn\nUDS), ISO_14229_3 (Unified diagnostic services on CAN implementation, UDSon-\nCAN) and ISO_14229_5 (Unified diagnostic services on Internet Protocol implemen-\ntation, UDSonIP) application layers shall be supported if their respective application\nlayer is available inside the ECU, all other application layers present in\nD-PDU API\nare\noptional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01124]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSupported protocols by\nD-PDU API\nimplementa-\ntion\n⌈\nISO UDS on CAN with Application layer ISO_15765_3, ISO UDS on CAN with\nApplication layer ISO_14229_3 (UDSonCAN) and ISO UDS on DoIP with Application\nlayer ISO_14229_5 (UDSonIP) protocols shall be supported, all other protocols are\noptional.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n65 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P66_87",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01125",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 66,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nThese protocols are present in 'Table B.2 - Standard protocol combination list' of ISO\n22900-2:2017(E).\n7.2.7.2 Not required D-PDU API concepts\nDynamic Link Libraries for Windows operating system are not required. The Windows\ninstallation process out of ISO 22900-2:2017(E) chapter 8.7.2 is not applicable to the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nwhich is using POSIX Operating System.\n[SWS_UCM_01125]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSeparation of\nD-PDU API\n-Software with the\nMVCI\nprotocol module firmware\n⌈\nA\nD-PDU API\nimplementation may be split at OSI-Layer\n4 into a\nD-PDU API\nimplementation on OSI-Layer 5 (usually in the PC itself) and the\nVCI\n-Module on OSI-Layers 3 and 4 (usually the\nVCI\nitself).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01126]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nRoot description file (\nRDF\n)\n⌈\nWithin an\nAUTOSAR\nAdaptive Platform\n, only one\nD-PDU API\nimplementation is required for\nUCM\n,\ntherefore the\nD-PDU API\nimplementation may not use the\nD-PDU API\nroot descrip-\ntion file (\nRDF\n).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe only instance of the\nD-PDU API\nwithin a\nSoftware Cluster\ncan be statically\nlinked with the Flashing Adapter.\n[SWS_UCM_01127]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nModule Description File (\nMDF\n)\n⌈\nThe\nD-PDU API\nim-\nplementation should not implement a protocol description file.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe supported protocol module types are fixed in the\nUCM\nuse case.\n[SWS_UCM_01128]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSymbolic names and IDs\n⌈\nThe Flashing Adapter may\noperate the\nD-PDU API\nwithout using symbolic names and IDs during runtime. If the\nuse case excludes frequent changes to the\nMDF\ns, simple Flashing Adapter may even\nhardcode (e.g. in a header file) all necessary IDs and operate the\nD-PDU API\nwithout\nsymbolic names.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01129]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSAE J2534-1 and RP 1210a compatibility\n⌈\nD-PDU\nAPI\nimplementation may not be compatible to SAE J2534-1 and RP 1210a.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\nThe Adaptive Platform does not need any migration path.\n[SWS_UCM_01130]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nComPrimitives in RawMode\n⌈\nD-PDU API\nimplemen-\ntation may not implement the IOCTL filter data structure.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n7.2.7.3 Not required D-PDU API functions\nPDULockResource() and PDUUnlockResource() are used to lock and unlock exclusive\naccess to a ComLogicalLink in case of parallel usage of the\nD-PDU API\nimplemen-\ntation by multiple applications on the same physical communication link. Flashing of\n66 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P67_88",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01131",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 67,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\na Classic ECU always requires some exclusive access and should be handled in the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\nitself.\n[SWS_UCM_01131]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_RESET)\n⌈\nThe parame-\nter PDU_IOCTL_RESET may not be implemented in\nD-PDU API\nimplementa-\ntion so the call of PDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_RESET) shall return the error code\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01132]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG_FILTER),\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER), PDUIoCtl(\nPDU_IOCTL_STOP_MSG_FILTER)\n⌈\nThe call of PDUIoCtl() with the pa-\nrameters PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG, PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER\nand PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER shall return the error code\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe parameters PDU_IOCTL_START_MSG, PDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER and\nPDU_IOCTL_CLEAR_MSG_FILTER are intended for the PassThru-Mode for com-\nprimitives and therefore an implementation is not required for the Flashing Adapter.\n[SWS_UCM_01133]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nPDUIoCtl(PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK)\n⌈\nThe IOCTL command PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK shall return\nPDU_ERR_ID_NOT_SUPPORTED.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThe IOCTL command PDU_IOCTL_SEND_BREAK is used to send a break signal on\nthe ComLogicalLink. A break signal can only be sent on certain physical layers (e.g.\nSAE J1850 VPW physical links and UART physical links) which are not supported by\nUCM\n.\n[SWS_UCM_01134]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nNot used\nD-PDU API\nfunction return codes\n⌈\nThe return codes PDU_ERR_CABLE_UNKNOWN, PDU_ERR_RSC_LOCKED,\nPDU_ERR_RSC_NOT_LOCKED, PDU_ERR_API_SW_OUT_OF_DATE and\nPDU_ERR_MODULE_FW_OUT_OF_DATE may not be implemented into the\nD-PDU API\nof the\nAUTOSAR Adaptive Platform\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\nThere is no cable attached to the ECU and therefore no cable detection return code\nPDU_ERR_CABLE_UNKNOWN could occur.\nLocking is not required for the Flashing Adapter, therefore PDU_ERR_RSC_LOCKED\nand PDU_ERR_RSC_NOT_LOCKED return code could not occur.\nThere is no separation of\nD-PDU API\n-Software with the\nMVCI\nprotocol module firmware required in the\nAUTOSAR Adap-\ntive Platform\n, so PDU_ERR_API_SW_OUT_OF_DATE and\nPDU_ERR_MODULE_FW_OUT_OF_DATE return codes could not occur.\n67 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P70_89",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01205",

      "source_page": 70,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.9: Campaign State Machine for OTA Client (\nTransferState\nfield)\nDiagrams 7.8 and 7.9 do not include behaviour after reset ([SWS_UCM_01205] for\nmore details)\n[SWS_UCM_01201] Sequential orchestration of campaigns\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall or-\nchestrate at most a single campaign at any one time.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01265] TransferState field\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide the state of a\ncampaign over the\nTransferState\nfield of the\nUCM Master\n's\nVehiclePackageM-\nanagement\nservice interface.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00042)\n[SWS_UCM_01203] CampaignState field\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide the state of a\ncampaign over the\nCampaignState\nfield of the\nUCM Master VehicleDriverAp-\nplication\nService Interface.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00042)\nThere is an overview of the cam-\npaign state machine in Fig. 7.8 detailing UCM Master campaign states and transitions.\n70 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P71_90",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01204",

      "source_page": 71,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.8.1 States\n[SWS_UCM_01204] Initial state\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall have\nkIdle\ndefault state.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01207] Trigger on\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate\n⌈\nOn\ntransition to\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate and if all UCM subordinates\npart of the campaign are in\nkIdle\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall start or resume transfer-\nring (\nTransferStart\nand\nTransferData\nas well as\nTransferExit\nif no streaming\nrequired) the software packages to the UCM subordinates according to the campaign\norchestration.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01209] Trigger on\nkProcessing\nstate\n⌈\nOn transition to\nkProcessing\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall call\nProcessSwPackage\nmethod to UCM subordinates to\nstart or resume processing the software packages ready for processing according to\nthe campaign orchestration.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_00210] Transferring of software packages on\nkProcessing\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkProcessing\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall transfer\nSoftware\nPackages\nto the UCM subordinates according to the campaign orchestration.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01212] Trigger on\nkActivating\nstate\n⌈\nOn transition to\nkActivating\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall ask\nUCM\nsubordinates to activate the software with\nActivate\nmethod call according to the campaign orchestration.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01214]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nFinal action on\nkVehicleChecking\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM\nMaster\nis in\nkVehicleChecking\nstate and receives the method\nVehicleCheck\ncall with parameter\nVehicleCheckResolution\n=True,\nUCM Master\nshall secondly\ncommit (\nFinish\n) the software on all\nUCM\nsubordinates part of the campaign.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01215]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTrigger on\nkCancelling\nstate\n⌈\nOn transition to\nkCancelling\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall first rollback (\nRollback\n) the software on all\nUCM\nsubordinates part of the campaign.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01216]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nFinal action on\nkCancelling\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkCancelling\nstate and the rollback of software on all\nUCM\nsubordinates is suc-\ncessful (successful\nRollback\nand transition from\nkRollingBack\nto\nkRolledBack\n),\nUCM Master\nshall secondly commit (\nFinish\n) the software on all UCM subordinates\npart of the campaign.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01217] Monitoring of UCM subordinates\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall sub-\nscribe to the\nCurrentStatus\nfield, in order to follow the current campaign from the\nstate of the UCM Subordinates.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n71 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.8.2 States Transitions\n[SWS_UCM_01218] Transition from\nkIdle\nstate to\nkSyncing\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Mas-\nter\nis in\nkIdle\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkSyncing\nstate on a request\nto\nGetSwClusterInfo\nor\nSwPackageInventory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_-\n00033)\n[SWS_UCM_01219] Transition from\nkSyncing\nstate to\nkIdle\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Mas-\nter\nis in\nkSyncing\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkIdle\nstate on completion of\nGetSwClusterInfo\nor\nSwPackageInventory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01220] Transition from\nkIdle\nstate to\nkVehiclePackageTrans-\nferring\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkIdle\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkVe-\nhiclePackageTransferring\nstate on successful completion of\nTransferVehi-\nclePackage\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01221]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransition from\nkVehiclePackageTransferring\nstate to\nkIdle\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkVehiclePackageTransferring\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkIdle\nstate on unsuccessful completion of\nTransfer-\nExit\n(\nVehicle Package\n) or successful completion of\nDeleteTransfer\n(\nVehicle\nPackage\n) or non recoverable error of\nTransferData\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_-\n00039)\n[SWS_UCM_01222] Transition from\nkVehiclePackageTransferring\nstate to\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkVehiclePack-\nageTransferring\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkSoftwarePackage_-\nTransferring\nstate on successful completion of\nTransferExit\n(\nVehicle Pack-\nage\n).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037, RS_UCM_00038)\n[SWS_UCM_01227] Transition from\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate to\nkIdle\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate,\nUCM\nMaster\nshall enter the\nkIdle\nstate on successful cancellation request (\nCancelCam-\npaign\n) or if there is a non recoverable transfer failure from one of the\nUCM\nsubordi-\nnates.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01228] Transition from\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate to\nkProcessing\nstate\n⌈\nWhen\nUCM Master\nis in\nkSoftwarePackage_Transfer-\nring\nstate, if all\nSoftware Packages\nare ready for processing, all Software Pack-\nages from all\nUCM\nsubordinates are at state\nkTransferred\n) or at least one\nSoftware\nPackage\nstarted being processed by\nProcessSwPackage\ncall to one\nUCM\nsubordi-\nnate according to the campaign orchestration,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkPro-\ncessing\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037, RS_UCM_00038, RS_UCM_-\n00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01229]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSafetyConditions while processing stream\n⌈\nIn the\ncase there is transition from\nkSoftwarePackage_Transferring\nstate to\nkPro-\ncessing\nstate, the SafetyConditions for\nkProcessing\nstate shall apply even though\nthere are\nSoftware Packages\ntransferring.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\n72 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\nIt is integrator's responsibility to make sure in this use case that safety conditions for\nProcessing will also cover safety approach of transferring.\n[SWS_UCM_01234]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransition from\nkProcessing\nstate to\nkActivat-\ning\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkProcessing\nstate and all software packages of the\ncampaign have been successfully (successful\nProcessSwPackage\n) processed and\nall UCM subordinates part to the campaign are in the\nkReady\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkActivating\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037, RS_UCM_-\n00038)\n[SWS_UCM_01236]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransition from\nkProcessing\nstate to\nkCan-\ncelling\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkProcessing\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter\nthe\nkCancelling\nstate on successful cancellation request (\nCancelCampaign\n) or\nin case of non recoverable processing failure of one of the\nUCM\nsubordinates.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01239]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransition from\nkActivating\nstate to\nkCan-\ncelling\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkActivating\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter\nthe\nkCancelling\nstate if any UCM subordinates part of the campaign unsuccess-\nfully (unsuccessful\nActivate\nand transition from\nkVerifying\nto\nkRollingBack\n)\ncompleted activation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01240] Transition from\nkActivating\nstate to\nkVehicleChecking\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkActivating\nstate,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkVehi-\ncleChecking\nstate if all UCM subordinates part of the campaign successfully (suc-\ncessful\nActivate\nand transition from\nkVerifying\nto\nkActivated\n) completed acti-\nvation.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_01241]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransition from\nkVehicleChecking\nstate to\nkCan-\ncelling\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkVehicleChecking\nstate and receives the\nmethod\nVehicleCheck\ncall with parameter\nVehicleCheckResolution\n=False,\nUCM\nMaster\nshall enter the\nkCancelling\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01242] Transition from\nkVehicleChecking\nstate to\nkIdle\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM Master\nis in\nkVehicleChecking\nstate and all UCM subordinates part of the\ncampaign transitioned from\nkCleaningUp\nto\nkIdle\n,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkIdle\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01243] Transition from\nkCancelling\nstate to\nkIdle\nstate\n⌈\nIf\nUCM\nMaster\nis in\nkCancelling\nstate and all UCM subordinates part of the campaign\ntransitioned from\nkCleaningUp\nto\nkIdle\n,\nUCM Master\nshall enter the\nkIdle\nstate.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01246]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nUnreachable UCM during update campaign\n⌈\nIn case\na\nUCM\nis not reachable by\nUCM Master\nduring an update campaign (from\nkTrans-\nferring\nor\nkUpdating\n),\nUCM Master\nshall cancel and go back to\nkIdle\n.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\n73 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P74_93",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01244",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 74,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.9 Campaign cancelling\nCancelCampaign\nmethod could be used at garage to unlock a blocked update. De-\ntails on action by\nUCM Master\n, like cleaning up the several\nUCM\ns, changing\nAUTOSAR\nAdaptive Platform\nstates, etc. are implementation specific.\nIn case an update campaign was cancelled, a new update campaign could use again\nthe already transferred\nSoftware Packages\n.\nUCM Master\ncould list transferred\nSoftware Packages\nby calling the\nUCM\nsubordinates with\nGetSwPackages\n.\n[SWS_UCM_01244]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancellation of an update campaign shall be pos-\nsible\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide method\nCancelCampaign\nto any of its client to\ncancel from\nkTransferring\nor\nkUpdating\nstates (from\nTransferState\nfield).\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)\n[SWS_UCM_01270]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nNew campaign disabling\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall remain\nin\nkIdle\nwhen a\nCancelCampaign\nmethod has been called with\nDisableCampaign\nparameter set.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01271]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nNew campaign enabling\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide\na method\nAllowCampaign\nto any of its client to reallow new campaign after a\nCancelCampaign\nmethod was called with\nDisableCampaign\nparameter set.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00035)\n[SWS_UCM_01273]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancelCampaign CancelFailed\nerror\n⌈\nCancel-\nCampaign\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError CancelFailed\nin case can-\ncelling of a campaign fails.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n[SWS_UCM_01274]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCancelCampaign OperationNotPermitted\nerror\n⌈\nCancelCampaign\nshall raise the error\nApplicationError OperationNotPer-\nmitted\nin case the\nUCM Master\nstates are at\nkIdle\n,\nkSyncing\nor\nkCancelling\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00020)\n7.2.10 Campaign Reporting\nAfter campaign is finished (finish method has been sent to all\nUCM\nsubordinates),\nUCM Master\nshould report to\nBackend\nserver status of the vehicle, with for instance\nupdated information of\nSoftware Clusters\npresent in vehicle.\n[SWS_UCM_01247] Method to read History Report\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall provide a\nmethod\nGetCampaignHistory\nto retrieve all actions that have been performed by\nUCM Master\nwhen exiting state\nkUpdating\nfrom a specific time window.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_-\n00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01248] Content of History Report\n⌈\nUCM Master\nshall save activation\ntime and activation result of processed\nVehicle Packages\nin the history.\n⌋\n(RS_-\nUCM_00034)\n74 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P75_94",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01266",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 75,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n[SWS_UCM_01266]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nSubordinate Not Available On The Network\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error SubordinateNotAvailableOnTheNetwork in\ncase one of the UCM subordinate involved in the current campaign stops offering its\nservice interface and later report it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01267]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle State Manager Communication Error\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error VehicleStateManagerCommunicationError\nin case the communication with Vehicle State Manager is not possible and later report\nit with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01268]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Driver Interface Communication Error\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall record persistently the error VehicleDriverInterfaceCommunicationError\nin case the communication with Vehicle Driver Interface is no longer possible and later\nreport it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n[SWS_UCM_01269]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nCampaign cancellation history\n⌈\nIf\nCancelCampaign\nmethod is called,\nUCM Master\nshall record persistently this event to later report it with\nGetCampaignHistory\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00034)\n7.2.11 Content of Vehicle Package"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P76_95",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_01301",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 76,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n(waiting passively for next reboot) to get activated. To optimize a campaign or fulfil\ndependencies, it could be required to activate\nSoftware Clusters\none after the\nother or several at once. To support all possible campaigns, the\nVehicle Pack-\nage\nincludes a model describing this coordination. It also contains a way to identify\nthe several involved\nUCM\ns for packages distribution within the vehicle and potentially\noverwriting default\nUCM Master\nfor this specific campaign.\nYou can find below for information purpose a description of the information that must\nbe contained in Vehicle Package manifest:\n•\nRepository: uri, repository or diagnostic address, for history, tracking and security\npurposes\n•\nVehicle description: vehicle description\n•\nVehicle Driver notifications: it might be needed to ask vehicle driver if\nUCM Mas-\nter\ncan start transferring\nSoftware Packages\n, processing it and activating it\nbut also inform him of the necessary safety requirements if applicable.\n•\nSafety policy: safety policy index to be used as argument to subscribe a field to\nvehicle safety manager. With this field,\nUCM Master\nwill be informed at any time\nof campaign if vehicle safety is met or not.\n•\nUCM Master\nidentifiers list: defines backup\nUCM Master\ns\n•\nCampaign orchestration: You can refer to [9] for more details. This campaign\nmodel allows to group activation of several\nUCM\ns and group\nSoftware Pack-\nages\nprocessing and transferring.\n[SWS_UCM_01301]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nauthentication\n⌈\nVehicle\nPackage\nshall be authenticated by\nUCM Master\nbefore any transfer of\nSoftware\nPackages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01302]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nauthentication failure\n⌈\nIn case\nVehicle Package\nauthentication fails at\nTransferExit\ncall,\nUCM Master\nshall\nraise the\nApplicationError AuthenticationFailed\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00039, RS_-\nUCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01303]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nDependencies between\nSoftware Packages\n⌈\nUCM\nMaster\nshall check dependencies based on\nVehicle Package Manifest\ns and\nSoftware Packages Manifest\ns before an transfer of\nSoftware Packages\n.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01305]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nVehicle Package\nformat\n⌈\nVehicle Package\nshall\ncontain\nVehicle Package\nmanifest and\nSoftware Packages\nmanifests of ARXML\nformat.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00043)\n[SWS_UCM_01306]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nTransferExit\nInvalid package manifest\n⌈\nTrans-\nferExit\nshall raise the error\nApplicationErrorInvalidPackageManifest\nupon receive of an invalid manifest.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00012)\n76 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P77_96",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00013",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement",
      "source_page": 77,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Update and Configuration\nManagement\nAUTOSAR AP R21-11\n7.2.12 Vehicle update security and confidentiality\nThe methods\nGetSwClusterInfo\n,\nSwPackageInventory\nand\nGetHistory\ncould\nuse private or confidential information.\n[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00013]\n⌊\nDRAFT\ng\nConfidential information protection\n⌈\nThe\nVehiclePackageManagement\nand\nVehicleDriverApplication\ninterfaces shall\nonly be called over secure communication channel providing confidentiality protection.\n⌋\n(RS_UCM_00033)\nThe\nGetSwClusterInfo\n,\nSwPackageInventory\n,\nGetCampaignHistory\n,\nGetSwClusterChangeInfo\n,\nGetHistory\n,\nGetSwClusterDescription\nand\nGetSwPackages\nmethods are using data that could identify vehicle user and there-\nfore should be protected for confidentiality.\n77 of 155 Document ID 888: AUTOSAR_SWS_UpdateAndConfigurationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_ucm_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_U_P79_97",
      "source_element": "SWS_UCM_00173",
